title.zh: 卷六十五 志第十七上: 河渠二
title.raw: 卷六十五 志第十七上: 河渠二 Volume 65 Treatises 18: Rivers and Canals 2

sentences.zh: 河渠二 ○黃河

translations.literal: Rivers and Canals 2 ○ Yellow River
translations.idiomatic: Rivers and Canals 2 — The Yellow River

sentences.zh: 黃河之水，其源遠而高，其流大而疾，其為患於中國者莫甚焉，前史載河決之患詳矣。

translations.literal: The water of the Yellow River: its source is distant and high, its current great and swift; no harm to China is greater, and previous histories record the harm of river breaches in detail.
translations.idiomatic: The Yellow River rises far upstream and runs high; its current is vast and swift. No scourge has afflicted China more grievously, and earlier histories already set down the calamities of its breaches at length.

sentences.zh: 世祖至元九年七月，衛輝路新鄉縣廣盈倉南河北岸決五十餘步。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the ninth year of Emperor Shizu's Zhiyuan era, on the north bank of the river south of Guangying Granary in Xinxiang County, Weihui Circuit, a breach of more than fifty paces occurred.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the ninth year of the Zhiyuan era (1272), the north bank of the river south of Guangying Granary in Xinxiang County, Weihui Circuit, burst open for more than fifty paces.

sentences.zh: 八月，又崩一百八十三步，其勢未已，去倉止三十步。

translations.literal: In the eighth month it collapsed again for one hundred eighty-three paces; the force had not yet ceased, and only thirty paces remained before the granary.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month another stretch of one hundred eighty-three paces gave way; the flood had not yet spent itself, and only thirty paces now stood between the river and the granary.

sentences.zh: 於是委都水監丞馬良弼與本路官同詣相視，差丁夫並力修完之。

translations.literal: Thereupon Ma Liangbi, Deputy Director of the Directorate of Waterways, was commissioned together with officials of the circuit to go and inspect the site, and corvée laborers were assigned to repair it jointly.
translations.idiomatic: The court then dispatched Ma Liangbi, deputy director of the Directorate of Waterways, together with circuit officials to survey the damage, and corvée laborers were levied to complete the repairs in concert.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，汴梁路陽武縣諸處河決二十二所，漂蕩麥禾房舍，委宣慰司督本路差夫修治。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year, at twenty-two places in Yangwu County, Bianliang Circuit, the river breached; wheat, grain, and houses were swept away, and the Pacification Commission was ordered to supervise corvée laborers of the circuit in repairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fifth year (1288), the river broke through at twenty-two places in Yangwu County and elsewhere along Bianliang Circuit, sweeping away grain and dwellings. The Pacification Commission was charged to oversee corvée repairs throughout the circuit.

sentences.zh: 成宗大德三年五月，河南省言：「河決蒲口兒等處，浸歸德府數郡，百姓被災，差官修築計料，合修七堤二十五處，共長三萬九千九十二步，總用葦四十萬四千束，徑尺樁二萬四千七百二十株，役夫七千九百二人。」

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the third year of Emperor Chengzong's Dade era, Henan Province reported: "The river breached at Pukou'er and other places, inundating several prefectures of Guide Prefecture; the people suffered disaster. Officials were dispatched to calculate materials for repair: seven dikes at twenty-five locations, totaling 39,092 paces in length, requiring 404,000 bundles of reeds, 24,720 piles one foot in diameter, and 7,902 laborers."
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the third year of the Dade era (1299), Henan Province reported that breaches at Pukou'er and elsewhere had flooded several districts of Guide Prefecture and brought disaster on the populace. Officials were sent to estimate repairs: seven dikes at twenty-five sites, 39,092 paces in all, requiring 404,000 bundles of reeds, 24,720 piles a foot thick, and 7,902 laborers.

sentences.zh: 武宗至大三年十一月，河北河南道廉訪司言：

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the third year of Emperor Wuzong's Zhida era, the Surveillance Commission of the Hebei-Henan Circuit reported:
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of the third year of the Zhida era (1310), the Surveillance Commission of the Hebei-Henan Circuit memorialized:

sentences.zh: 黃河決溢，千里蒙害，浸城郭，漂室廬壞禾稼，百姓已罹其毒。

translations.literal: The Yellow River breached and overflowed; for a thousand li harm spread, soaking city walls and ramparts, sweeping away houses and ruining grain; the people had already suffered its poison.
translations.idiomatic: When the Yellow River bursts its banks, harm spreads for a thousand li—walled towns are soaked, dwellings swept away, crops destroyed, and the common people already bear the full brunt of the disaster.

sentences.zh: 然後訪求修治之方，而且眾議紛紜，互陳利害，當事者疑惑不決，必須上請朝省，比至議定，其害滋大，所謂不預已然之弊。

translations.literal: Only then do they seek methods of repair, yet opinions are confused and each side states benefits and harms; those in charge hesitate and cannot decide, and must request the provincial court; by the time policy is settled the harm grows greater—the fault called failing to act before disaster is already upon one.
translations.idiomatic: Only afterward do officials cast about for remedies, while debate swirls and rival camps argue costs and benefits. Those responsible waver, policy must be referred upward, and by the time the court decides, the damage has only deepened—the classic failure to prepare before calamity strikes.

sentences.zh: 大抵黃河伏槽之時，水勢似緩，觀之不足為害，一遇霖潦，湍浪迅猛。

translations.literal: Generally when the Yellow River lies in its channel the water seems slow and appears insufficient to cause harm; but once heavy rains come, torrents and waves grow violent.
translations.idiomatic: For the most part, when the Yellow River rests in its bed the current seems gentle and hardly looks dangerous—yet once the rains of a wet season arrive, the torrent turns violent in an instant.

sentences.zh: 自孟津以東，土性疏薄，兼帶沙滷，又失導泄之方，崩潰決溢，可翅足而待。

translations.literal: From Mengjin eastward the soil is loose and thin, mixed with sand and brine, and methods of guiding and draining are lost; collapse, breach, and overflow may be awaited as swiftly as spreading wings.
translations.idiomatic: East of Mengjin the banks are loose and thin, laced with sand and salt, and with no proper channels to guide the flood off—breach and overflow can be expected almost at a glance.

sentences.zh: 近歲亳、潁之民，幸河北徙，有司不能遠慮，失於規畫，使陂濼悉為陸地。

translations.literal: In recent years the people of Bo and Ying were fortunate that the river shifted north of the He; the authorities could not take a long view and failed in planning, so that marshes and pools all became dry land.
translations.idiomatic: In recent years the people of Bo and Ying were spared only because the river shifted north of the Yellow River plain, yet officials lacked foresight in their planning and allowed ponds and marshes to be turned entirely into farmland.

sentences.zh: 東至杞縣三汊口，播河為三，分殺其勢，蓋亦有年。

translations.literal: East to the triple fork at Qi County the river was spread into three branches to divide and reduce its force—this had been so for years.
translations.idiomatic: As far east as the triple fork at Qi County, the river had long been divided into three channels to split and tame its force.

sentences.zh: 往歲歸德、大康建言，相次湮塞南北二汊，遂使三河之水合而為一，下流既不通暢，自然上溢為災。

translations.literal: In former years Guide and Dakang submitted proposals and in succession blocked the northern and southern branches, so that the waters of the three rivers merged into one; the lower course was no longer unobstructed, and naturally the river rose and overflowed as disaster.
translations.idiomatic: In earlier years officials of Guide and Dakang petitioned to block the northern and southern branches one after another, merging the three streams into a single course. With the lower reach no longer free to drain, the river naturally backed up and brought disaster.

sentences.zh: 由是觀之，是自奪分泄之利，故其上下決溢，至今莫除。

translations.literal: Viewed from this, they themselves took away the benefit of divided discharge; therefore breaches and overflows above and below have to this day not been removed.
translations.idiomatic: Seen in this light, the authorities had stripped away the very channels that relieved the flood; small wonder that breaches and overflows up and down the course remain unremedied to this day.

sentences.zh: 即今水勢趨下，有復鉅野、梁山之意，蓋河性遷徙無常，茍不為遠計預防，不出數年，曹、濮、濟、鄆蒙害必矣。

translations.literal: At present the water's force trends downward and shows intent to return to Juye and Liangshan; the nature of the river is to shift without constancy. If no long-range planning and prevention are made, within a few years Cao, Pu, Ji, and Yun will surely suffer harm.
translations.idiomatic: Even now the current is pressing southward with signs of returning toward Juye and Liangshan. The river's nature is to wander without fixed course; unless far-sighted precautions are taken, within a few years Cao, Pu, Ji, and Yun will inevitably be stricken.

sentences.zh: 今之所謂治水者，徒爾議論紛紜，咸無良策，水監之官，既非精選，知河之利害者百無一二。

translations.literal: Those who today are called river controllers merely debate in confusion, all without good plans; officials of the Water Directorate are not carefully chosen, and those who know the benefits and harms of the river are scarcely one or two in a hundred.
translations.idiomatic: Today's so-called river controllers do nothing but argue in circles, none with a sound plan. The Directorate's officers are not carefully chosen, and scarcely one in a hundred truly understands what the Yellow River can do for good or ill.

sentences.zh: 雖每年累驛而至，名為巡河，徒應故事，問地形之高下，則懵不知；

translations.literal: Although each year they arrive by relay post, called river inspection, they merely fulfill routine; asked about the height and low of terrain, they are ignorant and do not know;
translations.idiomatic: Though they ride the post roads each year on so-called river inspections, they merely go through the motions. Ask them about the lay of the land and they are utterly at a loss;

sentences.zh: 訪水勢之利病，則非所習。

translations.literal: inquire about the benefits and harms of the water's force, and that is not what they have practiced.
translations.idiomatic: inquire into the strengths and weaknesses of the current, and that lies outside their training altogether.

sentences.zh: 既無實才，又不經練。

translations.literal: They have neither real talent nor seasoned experience.
translations.idiomatic: They possess neither genuine ability nor seasoned experience.

sentences.zh: 乃或妄興事端，勞民動眾，阻逆水性，翻為後患。

translations.literal: Some even rashly raise affairs, exhausting the people and mobilizing the masses, obstructing and opposing the nature of the water, and turning into later harm.
translations.idiomatic: Some even stir up ill-conceived projects, exhausting the people and obstructing the river's natural course—only to create fresh disasters downstream.

sentences.zh: 為今之計，莫若於汴梁置都水分監，妙選廉幹、深知水利之人，專職其任，量存員數，頻為巡視，謹其防護，可疏者疏之，可堙者堙之，可防者防之。

translations.literal: For the present plan, nothing is better than establishing a metropolitan water sub-directorate at Bianliang, finely selecting upright and capable persons who deeply understand water works to hold the post exclusively, setting an appropriate number of staff, inspecting frequently, guarding carefully—what can be dredged, dredge; what can be blocked, block; what can be defended, defend.
translations.idiomatic: The best policy now is to establish a metropolitan water sub-directorate at Bianliang, appointing only upright, capable men who truly understand hydraulics to dedicated posts, maintaining an adequate staff for frequent inspection and vigilant defense—dredging where dredging is needed, blocking where blocking is needed, reinforcing where reinforcement is needed.

sentences.zh: 職掌既專，則事功可立。

translations.literal: Once duties are specialized, achievements can be established.
translations.idiomatic: Once responsibilities are clearly assigned, real results can be achieved.

sentences.zh: 較之河已決溢，民已被害，然後鹵莽修治以勞民者，烏可同日而語哉？

translations.literal: Compared with waiting until the river has already breached and overflowed and the people have already suffered harm, then making crude repairs to weary the people—how can these be spoken of in the same day?
translations.idiomatic: How can that be compared with waiting until the river has already burst, the people already ruined, and then rushing through hasty repairs that only exhaust them further?

sentences.zh: 於是省令都水監議，檢照大德十年正月省臣奏準，昨都水監升正三品，添官二員，鑄分監印，巡視御河，修缺潰，疏淺澀，禁民船越次亂行者，今擬就令分巡提點修治。

translations.literal: Thereupon the province ordered the Directorate of Waterways to deliberate, checking against the first month of the tenth year of Dade when provincial ministers memorialized and were approved: the Directorate had been raised to the third rank, two officials added, a sub-directorate seal cast, to inspect the Imperial Canal, repair breaches and leaks, dredge shallows and silting, and forbid civilian boats from passing out of order—the plan now was to have the sub-directorate tour and supervise repairs.
translations.idiomatic: The province then ordered the Directorate of Waterways to deliberate, citing the approved memorial of the first month of the tenth year of Dade (1306), when the Directorate was raised to the third rank, two posts added, and a sub-directorate seal cast to patrol the Imperial Canal, repair breaches, dredge shallows, and curb disorderly boat traffic. The proposal was now to charge that sub-directorate with touring the river and supervising repairs.

sentences.zh: 本監議：「黃河泛漲，止是一事，難與會通河有壩闡漕運分監守治為比。

translations.literal: The Directorate deliberated: 'Flooding of the Yellow River is only one matter; it is hard to compare with the grain-transport sub-directorate that guards the Huizong Canal with its dams and sluices.
translations.idiomatic: The Directorate replied: "Yellow River flooding is a distinct problem and cannot be equated with the grain-transport sub-directorate that maintains the Huizong Canal with its dams and sluice gates.

sentences.zh: 先為御河添官降印，兼提點黃河，若使專一，分監在彼，則有妨御河公事。

translations.literal: Previously officials and a seal were added for the Imperial Canal, with concurrent supervision of the Yellow River; if made exclusive, having the sub-directorate there would hinder Imperial Canal business.
translations.idiomatic: Officials and a seal were first added for the Imperial Canal with concurrent oversight of the Yellow River; if the sub-directorate were stationed there exclusively, duties on the Imperial Canal would suffer.

sentences.zh: 況黃河已有拘該有司正官提調，自今莫若分監官吏以十月往，與各處官司巡視缺破，會計工物督治，比年終完，來春分監新官至，則一一交割，然後代還，庶不相誤。」

translations.literal: Moreover the Yellow River already has the responsible regular officials in charge; from now it would be better for sub-directorate officers to go in the tenth month, tour with local offices to inspect gaps and breaks, tally labor and materials and supervise repairs, finish by year's end, and when the new sub-directorate chief arrives in spring next year hand over item by item and then return, so that duties do not conflict.'
translations.idiomatic: Besides, the Yellow River already has its own responsible officials in charge. Henceforth sub-directorate officers should depart in the tenth month, tour with local authorities to inspect breaches, tally materials, and supervise repairs to completion by year's end. When the new sub-directorate chief arrives the following spring, duties can be handed over one by one before the outgoing officers return, so that neither river is neglected."

sentences.zh: 工部照大德九年黃河決徙，逼近汴梁，幾至浸沒。

translations.literal: The Ministry of Works noted that in the ninth year of Dade the Yellow River breached and shifted course, approaching Bianliang and nearly inundating it.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Works observed that in the ninth year of Dade (1305) the Yellow River had breached and shifted course, pressing close to Bianliang and nearly submerging the city.

sentences.zh: 本處官司權宜開闢董盆口，分入巴河，以殺其勢，遂使正河水緩，並趨支流。

translations.literal: Local offices expediently opened the Dongpen mouth and divided flow into the Ba River to reduce its force, thus slowing the main current and sending it together toward branch streams.
translations.idiomatic: Local authorities as an expedient opened the Dongpen outlet and diverted water into the Ba River to reduce the main current's force, slowing the channel and drawing the flood toward subsidiary streams.

sentences.zh: 緣巴河舊隘不足吞伏，明年急遣蕭都水等閉塞，而其勢愈大，卒無成功，致連年為害，南至歸德諸處，北至濟寧地分，至今不息。

translations.literal: Because the old narrow Ba River could not swallow and contain it, the next year Xiao of the Directorate of Waterways and others were urgently sent to block it, yet the force grew greater and in the end there was no success, causing harm year after year from Guide in the south to the Jining region in the north, continuing to this day without cease.
translations.idiomatic: The old Ba River channel was too narrow to absorb the flow. The next year Xiao of the Directorate of Waterways and others were urgently dispatched to seal the outlet, yet the flood only grew fiercer and the effort failed utterly. Harm has recurred year after year from Guide in the south to the Jining region in the north, and has not ceased to this day.

sentences.zh: 本部議：「黃河為害，難同余水，欲為經遠之計，非用通知古今水利之人專任其事，終無補益。

translations.literal: This ministry deliberated: 'Harm from the Yellow River cannot be treated like other waters; to make a long-term plan, unless persons versed in water works ancient and modern are employed exclusively, in the end there will be no benefit.
translations.idiomatic: This ministry concluded: "The Yellow River cannot be managed like ordinary waterways. Without appointing men who truly understand hydraulics past and present to dedicated charge of the work, no lasting remedy will ever be achieved.

sentences.zh: 河南憲司所言詳悉，今都水監別無他見，止依舊例議擬未當。

translations.literal: What the Henan Surveillance Commission said is detailed and complete; the Directorate of Waterways now has no other view and merely following old precedent in deliberation is not appropriate.
translations.idiomatic: The Henan Surveillance Commission's analysis is thorough and sound. The Directorate of Waterways has no better proposal, and to rely merely on old precedent is inadequate.

sentences.zh: 如量設官，精選廉幹奉公、深知地形水勢者，專任河防之職，往來巡視，以時疏塞，庶可除害。」

translations.literal: If offices are set in appropriate number and upright, dedicated persons who deeply know terrain and water forces are finely selected to hold exclusively the duty of river defense, touring back and forth and dredging or blocking in season, harm may perhaps be removed.'
translations.idiomatic: If an appropriate corps of officials is established, selecting only upright, dedicated men who thoroughly understand terrain and current, charged exclusively with river defense and touring the course to dredge or block in due season, the scourge may finally be lifted."

sentences.zh: 省準令都水分監官專治河患，任滿交代。

translations.literal: The province approved and ordered metropolitan water sub-directorate officers to specialize in treating river disasters, handing over duties when terms expired.
translations.idiomatic: The province approved and ordered metropolitan water sub-directorate officers to specialize in river disasters, with orderly handover at the end of each term.

sentences.zh: 仁宗延祐元年八月，河南等處行中書省言：「黃河涸露舊水泊汙池，多為勢家所據，忽遇泛溢，水無所歸，遂致為害。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the first year of Emperor Renzong's Yanyou era, the Henan Branch Secretariat reported: 'When the Yellow River dries and exposes old pools and foul ponds, many are seized by powerful families; if sudden flooding occurs, the water has nowhere to go and thus brings harm.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the first year of the Yanyou era (1314), the Henan Branch Secretariat reported: "When the Yellow River falls low it exposes old ponds and marshes, many of which powerful families have seized. When sudden flooding comes, the water has nowhere to spread and disaster follows.

sentences.zh: 由此觀之，非河犯人，人自犯之。

translations.literal: Viewed from this, it is not that the river offends people—people offend themselves.
translations.idiomatic: Seen in this light, it is not the river that offends mankind—mankind brings the offense upon itself.

sentences.zh: 擬差知水利都水監官，與行省廉訪司同相視，可以疏辟堤障，比至泛溢，先加修治，用力少而成功多。

translations.literal: It is proposed to dispatch a Directorate of Waterways officer who knows water works, together with the provincial Surveillance Commission to inspect jointly; where dikes and barriers can be dredged and opened, repair before flooding arrives—less effort and greater success.
translations.idiomatic: We propose dispatching a Directorate officer versed in hydraulics together with the provincial Surveillance Commission to survey the course, opening dikes and barriers where possible and repairing them before the flood season—less labor for greater effect.

sentences.zh: 又汴梁路睢州諸處，決破河口數十，內開封縣小黃村計會月堤一道，都水分監修築障水堤堰，所擬不一。

translations.literal: Moreover at Sui Prefecture and other places along Bianliang Circuit, several tens of breached river mouths; within this, Kaifeng County's Xiaohuang Village planned a crescent dike, while the metropolitan water sub-directorate proposed building flood-barrier dikes and weirs—the plans were not uniform.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, at Sui Prefecture and elsewhere along Bianliang Circuit, several dozen river mouths had burst open. At Xiaohuang Village in Kaifeng County one plan called for a crescent dike, while the metropolitan water sub-directorate proposed flood-barrier dikes and weirs—the schemes did not agree.

sentences.zh: 宜委請行省官與本道憲司、汴梁路都水分監官及州縣正官，親歷按驗，從長講議。」

translations.literal: It is fitting to commission provincial officials together with this circuit's Surveillance Commission, Bianliang Circuit's metropolitan water sub-directorate officers, and regular prefectural and county officials to go in person and verify on site, deliberating according to the better plan.'
translations.idiomatic: Provincial officials should be commissioned together with the circuit Surveillance Commission, Bianliang's metropolitan water sub-directorate, and the regular prefectural and county authorities to inspect on site and adopt the soundest plan."

sentences.zh: 由是委太常丞郭奉政、前都水監丞邊承務、都水監卿朵兒只、河南行省石右丞、本道廉訪副使站木赤、汴梁判官張承直，上自河陰，下至陳州，與拘該州縣官一同沿河相視。

translations.literal: Thereupon Guo Fengzheng, Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices; Bian Chengwu, former Deputy Director of the Directorate of Waterways; Duo'erzhi, Director of the Directorate; Shi, Right Counselor of the Henan Branch Secretariat; Zhamuhe, Deputy Commissioner of the circuit Surveillance Commission; and Zhang Chengzhi, Bianliang Administrative Assistant, were commissioned from Heyin above down to Chen Prefecture below, together with the responsible prefectural and county officials to inspect along the river.
translations.idiomatic: Accordingly Guo Fengzheng of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, the former deputy director Bian Chengwu, director Duo'erzhi of the Directorate of Waterways, Right Counselor Shi of the Henan Branch Secretariat, Deputy Surveillance Commissioner Zhamuhe, and Bianliang Administrative Assistant Zhang Chengzhi were dispatched from Heyin down to Chen Prefecture, together with the responsible local officials, to survey the river course.

sentences.zh: 開封縣小黃村河口，測量比舊淺減六尺。

translations.literal: At the river mouth of Xiaohuang Village, Kaifeng County, measurement showed it was six feet shallower than before.
translations.idiomatic: At the Xiaohuang Village outlet in Kaifeng County, measurements showed the channel six feet shallower than before.

sentences.zh: 陳留、通許、太康舊有蒲葦之地，後因閉塞西河、塔河諸水口，以便種蒔，故他處連年潰決。

translations.literal: Chenliu, Tongxu, and Taikang had lands of reeds and rushes; later because the western river, Ta River, and other mouths were blocked to facilitate planting, other places suffered breaches year after year.
translations.idiomatic: Chenliu, Tongxu, and Taikang once had extensive reed marshes, but after the western river, Ta River, and other outlets were blocked for farming, breaches recurred year after year elsewhere along the course.

sentences.zh: 各官公議：「治水之道，惟當順其性之自然。

translations.literal: The officials jointly deliberated: 'The way to control water is only to follow its natural character.
translations.idiomatic: The officials jointly concluded: "The art of managing water lies solely in following its natural course.

sentences.zh: 嘗聞大河自陽武、胙城由白馬河間東北入海，歷年既久，遷徙不常。

translations.literal: It is heard that the great river from Yangwu and Zuocheng passed through Baima and Hejian northeast to enter the sea; years have been long and its shifts are not constant.
translations.idiomatic: It is said that long ago the great river ran from Yangwu and Zuocheng through Baima and Hejian northeast to the sea, shifting its course endlessly over the years.

sentences.zh: 每歲泛溢兩岸，時有沖決，強為閉塞，正及農忙，科樁梢，發丁夫，動至數萬，所費不可勝紀，其弊多端，郡縣嗷嗷，民不聊生。

translations.literal: Each year it floods both banks and sometimes bursts through; forcibly blocking it comes right at the busy farming season, levying piles and fascines and dispatching corvée laborers, often reaching tens of thousands; expense cannot be fully recorded, harms are many, prefectures and counties cry out, and the people cannot sustain life.
translations.idiomatic: Every year it floods both banks and sometimes bursts through. Forcible blocking always coincides with the peak of farming season, with piles and fascines levied and corvée laborers mobilized by the tens of thousands at costs beyond reckoning. Prefectures and counties are in uproar and the people can scarcely survive.

sentences.zh: 蓋黃河善遷徙，惟宜順下疏泄。

translations.literal: The Yellow River is apt to shift; only downstream drainage in accord with its course is fitting.
translations.idiomatic: The Yellow River is ever prone to wander; the only sound policy is to guide it downstream and let it drain freely.

sentences.zh: 今相視上自河陰，下抵歸德，經夏水漲，甚於常年，以小黃口分泄之故，並無沖決，此其明驗也。

translations.literal: On present inspection from Heyin above to Guide below, after summer rise the water was greater than an ordinary year; because of diversion at the Xiaohuang mouth there were no breaches at all—this is clear proof.
translations.idiomatic: On this inspection from Heyin down to Guide, the summer flood stood higher than in an ordinary year, yet thanks to diversion at the Xiaohuang outlet there were no breaches at all—clear proof of the policy's merit.

sentences.zh: 詳視陳州，最為低窪，瀕河之地，今歲麥禾不收，民饑特甚，欲為拯救，奈下流無可疏之處。

translations.literal: Inspecting Chen Prefecture in detail, it is lowest and most hollow; lands along the river this year reaped no wheat or grain, famine among the people is especially severe, and though rescue is desired, below there is nowhere that can be dredged.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Prefecture proved the lowest and most vulnerable stretch along the river. This year wheat and grain failed entirely and famine was severe. Though rescue was urgently needed, there was nowhere downstream that could be opened to receive the flood.

sentences.zh: 若將小黃村河口閉塞，必移患鄰郡；

translations.literal: If the Xiaohuang Village river mouth were blocked, harm would surely shift to neighboring prefectures;
translations.idiomatic: If the Xiaohuang Village outlet were sealed, disaster would simply shift to neighboring prefectures;

sentences.zh: 決上流南岸，則汴梁被害；

translations.literal: if the upper south bank were breached, Bianliang would suffer harm;
translations.idiomatic: if the upper course were breached on the south bank, Bianliang would be stricken;

sentences.zh: 決下流北岸，則山東可憂。

translations.literal: if the lower north bank were breached, Shandong would be cause for concern.
translations.idiomatic: if the lower north bank were breached, Shandong would be at grave risk.

sentences.zh: 事難兩全，當遺小就大。

translations.literal: The matter is hard to satisfy both sides; one should leave the small and take the large.
translations.idiomatic: Both courses cannot be fully secured; the lesser harm must be accepted to avert the greater.

sentences.zh: 如免陳村差稅，賑其饑民，陳留、通許、太康縣被災之家，依例取勘賑恤，其小黃村河口仍舊通流外，據修築月堤，並障水堤，閉河口，別難擬議。」

translations.literal: Such as exempting Chen Village from corvée and tax, relieving its famine victims; in Chenliu, Tongxu, and Taikang counties disaster households should be surveyed and relieved according to precedent; aside from keeping the Xiaohuang Village mouth open as before, regarding building crescent dikes and flood-barrier dikes and closing river mouths, other plans are hard to propose.'
translations.idiomatic: Chen Village's corvée and taxes should be remitted and its starving people relieved; disaster households in Chenliu, Tongxu, and Taikang should be surveyed and aided according to precedent. Beyond keeping the Xiaohuang outlet open as before, proposals to build crescent dikes, flood barriers, or seal the mouth altogether are difficult to endorse."

sentences.zh: 於是凡汴梁所轄州縣河堤，或已修治，及當疏通與補築者，條列具備。

translations.literal: Thereupon all river dikes under Bianliang's jurisdiction—those already repaired and those to be dredged or supplemented—were listed in full detail.
translations.idiomatic: A full inventory was then drawn up of every dike under Bianliang's jurisdiction, whether already repaired or still requiring dredging and reinforcement.

sentences.zh: 至五年正月，河北河南道廉訪副使奧屯言：「近年河決杞縣小黃村口，滔滔南流，莫能禦遏，陳、潁瀕河膏腴之地浸沒，百姓流散。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fifth year, Deputy Surveillance Commissioner Aotun of the Hebei-Henan Circuit reported: 'In recent years the river breached at Xiaohuang Village mouth in Qi County and flowed south in torrents, unable to be checked; fertile lands along the Chen and Ying rivers were inundated and the people scattered.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the fifth year (1318), Deputy Surveillance Commissioner Aotun of the Hebei-Henan Circuit reported: "In recent years the river has burst at the Xiaohuang Village mouth in Qi County and poured south in an unchecked torrent, inundating the fertile lands along the Chen and Ying rivers and driving the people into exile.

sentences.zh: 今水迫汴城，遠無數里，儻值霖雨水溢，倉卒何以防禦！

translations.literal: Now the water presses on Bian City, not several li distant; if heavy rains cause overflow, how can it be defended in haste!
translations.idiomatic: The flood now presses within a few li of Bian City. Should the rains of a wet season swell the river, what defense could be mounted in time!

sentences.zh: 方今農隙，宜為講究，使水歸故道，達於江、淮，不惟陳、潁之民得遂其生，竊恐將來浸灌汴城，其害匪輕。」

translations.literal: At present in the farming interval it is fitting to study the matter, making the water return to its old course and reach the Yangtze and Huai—not only so the people of Chen and Ying may secure their livelihood, but I fear lest in future Bian City be flooded and irrigated; the harm would not be light.'
translations.idiomatic: Now, during the farming lull, the matter should be studied so that the river may be returned to its old course and reach the Yangtze and Huai—not only to restore life to the people of Chen and Ying, but because I fear that Bian City itself may one day be inundated, with harm beyond measure."

sentences.zh: 於是大司農司下都水監移文汴梁分監修治，自六年二月十一日興工，至三月九日工畢，總計北至槐疙疸兩舊堤，南至窯務汴堤，通長二十里二百四十三步。

translations.literal: Thereupon the Grand Secretariat for Agriculture ordered the Directorate of Waterways to send documents to the Bianliang sub-directorate for repairs; work began on the eleventh day of the second month of the sixth year and was completed on the ninth day of the third month, totaling from the two old dikes north at Huai Geda to the Bian dike south at Yaowu—a total length of twenty li and 243 paces.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Secretariat for Agriculture then directed the Directorate of Waterways to order the Bianliang sub-directorate to undertake repairs. Work began on the eleventh day of the second month of the sixth year (1319) and was finished on the ninth day of the third month, running from the two old dikes at Huai Geda in the north to the Bian dike at Yaowu in the south—a total length of twenty li and 243 paces.

sentences.zh: 創修護城堤一道，長七千四百四十三步，下地修堤，下廣十六步，上廣四步，高一丈，六十尺為一工。

translations.literal: A new city-protection dike was built, 7,443 paces long; building the dike on low ground: base width sixteen paces, top width four paces, height one zhang; sixty feet counted as one work unit.
translations.idiomatic: A new city-protection dike was constructed, 7,443 paces in length, with a base sixteen paces wide, a crown four paces wide, and a height of one zhang; labor was reckoned at one work unit per sixty feet.

sentences.zh: 堤東二十步外取土，內河溝七處，深淺高下闊狹不一，計工二十五萬三千六百八十，用夫八千四百五十三，除風雨妨工，三十日畢。

translations.literal: Earth was taken twenty paces east of the dike; within were seven river channels of varying depth, height, and width, totaling 253,680 work units and employing 8,453 laborers; excluding days lost to wind and rain, it was completed in thirty days.
translations.idiomatic: Earth was taken from twenty paces east of the dike. Seven inner channels of varying depth and width required 253,680 work units and 8,453 laborers; allowing for days lost to wind and rain, the work was finished in thirty days.

sentences.zh: 內流水河溝，南北闊二十步，水深五尺。

translations.literal: The inner flowing river channel was twenty paces wide north to south, with water five feet deep.
translations.idiomatic: The inner drainage channel ran twenty paces wide from north to south with a depth of five feet.

sentences.zh: 河內修堤，底闊二十四步，上廣八步，高一丈五尺，積十二萬尺，取土稍遠，四十尺為一工，計三萬工，用夫百人。

translations.literal: Dikes repaired within the river: base width twenty-four paces, top width eight paces, height one zhang five feet, volume 120,000 cubic feet; earth was taken somewhat farther, forty feet per work unit, totaling 30,000 units and employing one hundred laborers.
translations.idiomatic: Dikes within the river channel were rebuilt with a base twenty-four paces wide, a crown eight paces wide, and a height of one zhang five feet, totaling 120,000 cubic feet of fill. Earth was drawn from somewhat farther away, reckoned at one work unit per forty feet, 30,000 units in all, with one hundred laborers employed.

sentences.zh: 每步用大樁二，計四十，各長一丈二尺，徑四寸。

translations.literal: Per pace two large piles, forty in total, each one zhang two feet long and four inches in diameter.
translations.idiomatic: Two large piles per pace were used, forty in all, each one zhang two feet long and four inches thick.

sentences.zh: 每步雜草千束，計二萬。

translations.literal: Per pace one thousand bundles of mixed grass, totaling twenty thousand.
translations.idiomatic: One thousand bundles of fascine grass per pace were required, twenty thousand in all.

sentences.zh: 每步簽樁四，計八十，各長八尺，徑三寸。

translations.literal: Per pace four stake-piles, eighty in total, each eight feet long and three inches in diameter.
translations.idiomatic: Four securing stakes per pace were driven, eighty in all, each eight feet long and three inches thick.

sentences.zh: 水手二十，木匠二，大船二艘，梯一副，繩索畢備。

translations.literal: Twenty sailors, two carpenters, two large boats, one set of gangways, ropes fully provided.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty sailors, two carpenters, two large boats, one set of gangways, and ropes in full supply were deployed.

sentences.zh: 七年七月，汴梁路言：「滎澤縣六月十一日河決塔海莊東堤十步余，橫堤兩重，又缺數處。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the seventh year, Bianliang Circuit reported: 'On the eleventh day of the sixth month in Xingyang County the river breached the east dike at Tahai Village for more than ten paces; cross-dikes in two layers also had several gaps.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the seventh year (1320), Bianliang Circuit reported that on the eleventh day of the sixth month the river had breached the east dike at Tahai Village in Xingyang County for more than ten paces, and that two layers of cross-dikes had several gaps as well.

sentences.zh: 二十三日夜，開封縣蘇村及七里寺復決二處。」

translations.literal: On the night of the twenty-third, Su Village and Qilisi in Kaifeng County breached again at two places.'
translations.idiomatic: On the night of the twenty-third, two fresh breaches opened at Su Village and Qilisi in Kaifeng County.

sentences.zh: 本省平章站馬赤親率本路及都水監官，並工修築，於至治元年正月興工，修堤岸四十六處，該役一百二十五萬六千四百九十四工，凡用夫三萬一千四百一十三人。

translations.literal: Zhamuhe, Pacification Commissioner of the province, personally led circuit and Directorate of Waterways officials in joint repair; work began in the first month of the first year of Zhizhi, repairing dikes and banks at forty-six places, totaling 1,256,494 work units and employing 31,413 laborers.
translations.idiomatic: Pacification Commissioner Zhamuhe of the province personally led circuit and Directorate officials in joint repairs. Work began in the first month of the first year of Zhizhi (1321), restoring dikes at forty-six sites for 1,256,494 work units and 31,413 laborers in all.

sentences.zh: 文宗至順元年六月，曹州濟陰縣河防官本縣尹郝承務言：「六月五日，魏家道口黃河舊堤將決，不可修築，以此差募民夫，創修護水月堤，東西長三百九步，下闊六步，高一丈。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the first year of Emperor Wenzong's Zhishun era, Hao Chengwu, river-defense officer and magistrate of Jiyin County, Cao Prefecture, reported: 'On the fifth day of the sixth month the old Yellow River dike at Weijiadao mouth was about to breach and could not be repaired; corvée laborers were therefore levied to build a new flood-protection crescent dike, 309 paces long east to west, six paces wide at the base, one zhang high.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the first year of the Zhishun era (1330), Hao Chengwu, river-defense officer and magistrate of Jiyin County in Cao Prefecture, reported that on the fifth day of the sixth month the old Yellow River dike at Weijiadao was on the verge of collapse and could not be patched in place. Corvée laborers were therefore mobilized to build a new flood-protection crescent dike 309 paces long east to west, six paces wide at the base, and one zhang high.

sentences.zh: 又緣水勢瀚漫，復於近北築月堤，東西長一千餘步，下廣九步，其功未竟。

translations.literal: Moreover because the water's force spread vast, another crescent dike was built nearby to the north, more than a thousand paces long east to west, nine paces wide at the base; the work was not yet finished.
translations.idiomatic: As the flood spread still wider, a second crescent dike was begun to the north, more than a thousand paces long and nine paces wide at the base, but the work was not yet complete.

sentences.zh: 至二十一日，水忽泛溢，新舊三堤一時咸決，明日外堤復壞，急率民閉塞，而湍流迅猛，有蛇時出沒於中，所下樁土，一掃無遺。

translations.literal: By the twenty-first day the water suddenly overflowed; all three dikes, new and old, breached at once; the next day the outer dike broke again; laborers were urgently led to block it, yet the torrent was violent, snakes sometimes appearing within it, and piles and earth cast in were swept away without trace.
translations.idiomatic: On the twenty-first day the river suddenly surged. All three dikes, old and new, gave way at once; the next day the outer dike collapsed again. Laborers were rushed to the breach, but the torrent was fierce—snakes were seen writhing in the current—and every stake and load of earth was swept away without a trace.

sentences.zh: 又舊堤歲久，多有缺壞，差夫並工築成二十餘步。

translations.literal: Moreover the old dike, years old, had many gaps and breaks; laborers were assigned to repair jointly more than twenty paces.
translations.idiomatic: The old dike, worn by years of service, had many gaps; laborers were assigned to rebuild more than twenty paces of it in concert.

sentences.zh: 其魏家道口缺堤，東西五百餘步，深二丈餘，外堤缺口，東西長四百餘步。

translations.literal: At Weijiadao the gap in the dike was more than five hundred paces east to west and more than two zhang deep; the outer dike's breach was more than four hundred paces long east to west.
translations.idiomatic: At Weijiadao the breach in the dike ran more than five hundred paces east to west and over two zhang deep; the outer dike's gap extended more than four hundred paces.

sentences.zh: 又磨子口護水堤，低薄不足禦水，東西長一千五百步。

translations.literal: Moreover the flood-protection dike at Mozikou was low and thin, insufficient to resist the water, 1,500 paces long east to west.
translations.idiomatic: The flood-protection dike at Mozikou was likewise low and thin, inadequate to hold the water, and ran 1,500 paces east to west.

sentences.zh: 魏家道口卒未易修，先差夫補築。

translations.literal: Weijiadao in the end was not easy to repair; laborers were first assigned to patch and build elsewhere.
translations.idiomatic: Weijiadao could not quickly be restored; laborers were first assigned to patch the more manageable sections.

sentences.zh: 磨子口七月十六日興工，二十八日工畢。

translations.literal: At Mozikou work began on the sixteenth day of the seventh month and was completed on the twenty-eighth.
translations.idiomatic: At Mozikou work began on the sixteenth day of the seventh month and was completed on the twenty-eighth.

sentences.zh: 二十二日，按視至朱從馬頭西，舊堤缺壞，東西長一百七十餘步，計料堤外貼築五步，增高一丈二尺，與舊堤等，上廣二步。

translations.literal: On the twenty-second day inspection reached west of Zhucong Matou; the old dike was broken for more than 170 paces east to west; materials were calculated to build five paces outward from the dike, raising height by one zhang two feet to equal the old dike, top width two paces.
translations.idiomatic: On the twenty-second day the inspection reached west of Zhucong Matou, where the old dike had failed for more than 170 paces. Materials were calculated to face the dike outward by five paces, raising its height by one zhang two feet to match the old level, with a crown two paces wide.

sentences.zh: 於磨子口修堤夫內，摘差三百一十人，於是月二十三日入役，至閏七月四日工畢。」

translations.literal: From among the Mozikou dike-repair laborers, 310 were selected and assigned; they entered service on the twenty-third day of that month and work was completed on the fourth day of the intercalary seventh month.'
translations.idiomatic: From the laborers at Mozikou, 310 were detailed for this task. They entered service on the twenty-third day of that month and finished on the fourth day of the intercalary seventh month.

sentences.zh: 郝承務又言：「魏家道口磚堌等村，缺破堤堰，累下樁土，沖洗不存，若復閉築，緣缺堤周回皆泥淖，人不可居，兼無取土之處。

translations.literal: Hao Chengwu further reported: 'At Weijiadao, Zhuan'gu, and other villages the dikes and weirs were broken; piles and earth repeatedly cast in were washed away without remaining. If blocking and building were attempted again, because around the gap in the dike all is mud and mire, people cannot dwell there, and moreover there is no place to take earth.
translations.idiomatic: Hao Chengwu added: "At Weijiadao, Zhuan'gu, and neighboring villages the dikes lie in ruins. Stakes and earth have been cast in again and again only to be washed away. Any attempt to seal the breach is futile—the ground roundabout is nothing but mud and mire, uninhabitable, with nowhere left to draw fill.

sentences.zh: 又沛郡安樂等保，去歲旱災，今復水澇，漂禾稼，壞室廬，民皆缺食，難於差倩。

translations.literal: Moreover in Pei Prefecture the Anle and other baos suffered drought disaster last year and now flood again; grain was swept away and houses ruined; the people all lack food and it is hard to levy labor.
translations.idiomatic: In Pei Prefecture the Anle district and others suffered drought last year and flood again this year—crops swept away, dwellings destroyed, the people without food. Corvée labor is scarcely to be had.

sentences.zh: 其不經水害村保民人，先已遍差補築黃家橋、磨子口諸處堤堰，似難重役。

translations.literal: Those village people in baos not affected by water disaster have already been universally levied to repair dikes at Huangjiaqiao, Mozikou, and other places; it seems hard to impose service again.
translations.idiomatic: Villages that escaped the flood have already been levied wholesale to repair dikes at Huangjiaqiao, Mozikou, and elsewhere; a second round of corvée seems impossible.

sentences.zh: 如候秋涼水退，倩夫修理，庶蘇民力。

translations.literal: If one waits until autumn coolness when the water recedes and then hires laborers for repair, perhaps the people's strength may be revived.
translations.idiomatic: If repairs wait until autumn, when the waters fall and the weather cools, hired labor may restore the people's strength.

sentences.zh: 今沖破新舊堤七處，共長一萬二千二百二十八步，下廣十二步，上廣四步，高一丈二尺，計用夫六千三百四人，樁九百九十，葦箔一千三百二十，草一萬六千五束。

translations.literal: Now seven places where new and old dikes were breached, totaling 12,228 paces in length, base width twelve paces, top width four paces, height one zhang two feet, calculated to require 6,304 laborers, 990 piles, 1,320 reed mats, and 16,500 bundles of grass.
translations.idiomatic: Seven breaches in old and new dikes now total 12,228 paces in length, with a base twelve paces wide, a crown four paces wide, and a height of one zhang two feet. The estimate calls for 6,304 laborers, 990 piles, 1,320 reed mats, and 16,500 bundles of fascine grass.

sentences.zh: 六十尺為一工，無風雨妨工，度五十日可畢。」

translations.literal: Sixty feet count as one work unit; without wind and rain hindering work, it is estimated completion in fifty days.'
translations.idiomatic: Labor is reckoned at one unit per sixty feet; barring days lost to wind and rain, the work should be finished in fifty days."

sentences.zh: 本縣準言，至八月三十日差夫二千四百二十，關請郝承務督役。

translations.literal: The county approved the report; by the thirtieth day of the eighth month 2,420 laborers were assigned, and Hao Chengwu was requested to supervise the work.
translations.idiomatic: The county approved the plan, and by the thirtieth day of the eighth month 2,420 laborers were levied under Hao Chengwu's supervision.

sentences.zh: 郝承務又言：「九月三日興工修築，至十八日大風，十九日雨，二十四日復雨，緣此辛馬頭、孫家道口障水堤堰又壞，計工役倍於元數，移文本縣，添差二千人同築。

translations.literal: Hao Chengwu again reported: 'Repair work began on the third day of the ninth month; on the eighteenth came great wind, on the nineteenth rain, on the twenty-fourth rain again; because of this the flood-barrier dikes at Xinmatou and Sunjiadao broke again; estimated labor doubled the original figure; documents were sent to the county requesting 2,000 additional laborers for joint building.
translations.idiomatic: Hao Chengwu reported further: "Repairs began on the third day of the ninth month. On the eighteenth came a great gale, on the nineteenth rain, and on the twenty-fourth rain again. The flood barriers at Xinmatou and Sunjiadao collapsed anew, doubling the labor required. He petitioned the county for two thousand additional workers.

sentences.zh: 二十六日，元與成武定、陶二縣分築魏家道口八百二十步修完。

translations.literal: On the twenty-sixth day, Yuan together with Chengwu Ding and Tao counties divided the building and completed 820 paces at Weijiadao.
translations.idiomatic: On the twenty-sixth day, Yuan together with Ding of Chengwu and Tao counties completed 820 paces of repairs at Weijiadao by divided labor.

sentences.zh: 十月二日，至辛馬頭、孫家道口，從實又量元缺堤，南北闊一百四十步，內水地五十步，深者至二丈，淺者不下八九尺，依元料用樁箔補築，至七日完。

translations.literal: On the second day of the tenth month, reaching Xinmatou and Sunjiadao, the original gap in the dike was measured in fact: 140 paces wide north to south, fifty paces of water within, deep places reaching two zhang, shallow places not less than eight or nine feet; according to original materials piles and mats were used to patch and build, completed by the seventh day.
translations.idiomatic: On the second day of the tenth month work reached Xinmatou and Sunjiadao. The breach was remeasured at 140 paces north to south, with fifty paces under water—two zhang deep in places, no less than eight or nine feet in the shallows. Repairs with piles and mats according to the original estimate were completed by the seventh day.

sentences.zh: 又於本處創築月堤一道，西北東南斜長一千六百二十七步，內成武、定陶分築一百五十步，實築一千四百七十七步，外有元料堌頭魏家道口外堤未築。

translations.literal: Moreover at this place a new crescent dike was built, 1,627 paces long diagonally northwest to southeast; within this Chengwu and Dingtao built 150 paces in division, actually building 1,477 paces; outside this, according to original materials, the outer dike head at Weijiadao was not yet built.
translations.idiomatic: A new crescent dike was also built on site, 1,627 paces long on a northwest-southeast diagonal. Chengwu and Dingtao contributed 150 paces by divided labor, leaving 1,477 paces built here; the outer dike head at Weijiadao, included in the original estimate, remained unfinished.

sentences.zh: 即欲興工，緣冬寒土凍，擬候來春，並工修理，官民兩便。

translations.literal: They wished to begin work at once, but because winter cold froze the earth, it is planned to wait until next spring and repair jointly, convenient for both government and people.
translations.idiomatic: Work was to begin at once, but winter cold had frozen the ground; repairs are planned for the coming spring, when joint labor will serve both the state and the people.

sentences.zh: 濟州河

translations.literal: Jizhou River
translations.idiomatic: The Jizhou Canal

sentences.zh: 濟州河者，新開以通漕運也。

translations.literal: The Jizhou River was newly opened to connect grain transport.
translations.idiomatic: The Jizhou Canal was newly excavated to link the grain-transport network.

sentences.zh: 世祖至元十七年七月，耿參政、阿裏尚書奏：「為姚演言開河事，令阿合馬與耆舊臣集議，以鈔萬錠為傭直，仍給糧食。」

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the seventeenth year of Emperor Shizu's Zhiyuan era, Participating Counselor Geng and Minister Ali memorialized: 'Regarding Yao Yan's proposal to open the river, let Ahmad convene elder ministers for joint deliberation, with ten thousand ingots of paper money as wages, and grain still provided.'
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the seventeenth year of the Zhiyuan era (1280), Participating Counselor Geng and Minister Ali memorialized that, regarding Yao Yan's proposal to open the canal, Ahmad should convene senior ministers to deliberate, with ten thousand ingots of paper money set aside as wages and grain rations provided as well.

sentences.zh: 世祖從之。

translations.literal: The Emperor Shizu approved.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor approved.

sentences.zh: 十八年九月，中書丞相火魯火孫等奏：「姚總管等言，請免益都、淄萊、寧海三州一歲賦，入折傭直，以為開河之用。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the eighteenth year, Chief Counselor Huoluohusun and others of the Central Secretariat memorialized: 'Director-General Yao and others request exemption of one year's tax from Yidu, Zilai, and Ninghai prefectures, converting it into wages for opening the river.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the eighteenth year (1281), Chief Counselor Huoluohusun and others of the Central Secretariat reported that Director-General Yao and his colleagues asked that one year's tax from Yidu, Zilai, and Ninghai be remitted and converted into wages for opening the canal.

sentences.zh: 平章阿合馬與諸老臣議，以為一歲民賦雖多，較之官給傭直，行之甚便。」

translations.literal: Pacification Commissioner Ahmad and various elder ministers deliberated and held that though one year's civilian tax was great, compared with official payment of wages it was very convenient to implement.'
translations.idiomatic: Pacification Commissioner Ahmad and the senior ministers concluded that although a year's tax levy was substantial, converting it to wages was far more convenient than disbursement from the treasury.

sentences.zh: 遂從之。

translations.literal: They then approved.
translations.idiomatic: The proposal was approved.

sentences.zh: 十月，火魯火孫等奏：「阿八失所開河，經濟州，而其地又有一河，傍有民田，開之甚便。

translations.literal: In the tenth month Huoluohusun and others memorialized: 'The river opened by Abahsi passes through Jizhou, and in that place there is another river beside civilian fields; opening it would be very convenient.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Huoluohusun and others reported that the canal Abahsi had opened ran through Jizhou, where another stream lay beside farmland and could conveniently be opened as well.

sentences.zh: 臣等議，若開此河，阿八失所管一方屯田，宜移之他處，不阻水勢。」

translations.literal: Your subjects deliberated that if this river is opened, the garrison fields Abahsi administers in one area should be moved elsewhere so as not to obstruct the water's force.'
translations.idiomatic: We propose that if this channel is opened, the garrison farms under Abahsi's jurisdiction in that area should be relocated so as not to obstruct the current.

sentences.zh: 世祖令移之。

translations.literal: The Emperor Shizu ordered them moved.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor ordered the relocation.

sentences.zh: 十二月，差奧魯赤、劉都水及精算數者一人，給宣差印，往濟州，定開河夫役，令大名、衛州新附軍亦往助工。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month Oruji, Liu of the Directorate of Waterways, and one skilled in calculation were dispatched, given an imperial commissioner seal, sent to Jizhou to fix corvée for opening the river, and the newly submitted armies of Daming and Weizhou were also ordered to assist the work.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Oruji, Liu of the Directorate of Waterways, and a skilled calculator were dispatched with an imperial commissioner seal to Jizhou to fix corvée quotas for the excavation, and the newly submitted armies of Daming and Weizhou were ordered to assist.

sentences.zh: 三十一年，御史臺言：「膠、萊海道淺澀，不能行舟。」

translations.literal: In the thirty-first year the Censorate reported: 'The Jiao-Lai sea route is shallow and silted and cannot accommodate boats.'
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-first year the Censorate reported that the Jiao-Lai sea route had silted up and could no longer carry shipping.

sentences.zh: 臺官玉速帖木兒奏：「阿八失所開河，省遣牙亦速失來，謂漕船泛河則失少，泛海則損多。」

translations.literal: Censor Yisutiemuer memorialized: 'The river Abahsi opened—the province sent Yiyasushi, who said that if grain boats go by river losses are few, but by sea losses are many.'
translations.idiomatic: Censor Yisutiemuer added that the province had sent Yiyasushi, who argued that grain transport by river incurred fewer losses than by sea.

sentences.zh: 既而漕臣囊加<角┦>、萬戶孫偉又言：「漕海舟疾且便。」

translations.literal: Then grain-transport officials Nangajia Lu and Commander Sun Wei again said: 'Sea transport is swift and convenient.'
translations.idiomatic: Grain officials Nangajia Lu and Commander Sun Wei then argued that sea transport was both swift and convenient.

sentences.zh: 右丞麥術丁又奏：「斡奴兀奴<角┦>凡三移文，言阿八失所開河，益少損多，不便轉漕。

translations.literal: Right Counselor Maishuding again memorialized: 'Wanuwunu Lu three times sent documents saying Abahsi's opened river brings little benefit and much loss, inconvenient for turning grain transport.
translations.idiomatic: Right Counselor Maishuding reported that Wanuwunu Lu had thrice written that Abahsi's canal brought little gain and much loss and was ill suited to grain transport.

sentences.zh: 水手軍人二萬，舟千艘，見閑不用，如得之，可歲漕百萬石。

translations.literal: Twenty thousand sailor-soldiers and a thousand boats now stand idle unused; if employed, a million shi could be transported yearly.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty thousand sailor-soldiers and a thousand vessels now lie idle; properly deployed, they could move a million shi of grain each year.

sentences.zh: 昨奉旨，候忙古<角┦>來共議，海道便，則阿八失河可廢。

translations.literal: Yesterday an imperial order awaited Manggu Lu's arrival for joint deliberation: if the sea route is convenient, Abahsi's river may be abandoned.
translations.idiomatic: An earlier edict had awaited Manggu Lu's arrival for joint deliberation: if the sea route proved satisfactory, Abahsi's canal could be abandoned.

sentences.zh: 今忙古<角┦>已自海道運糧回，有一二南人自願運糧萬石，已許之。」

translations.literal: Now Manggu Lu has already returned from transporting grain by sea route; one or two southerners voluntarily offered to transport ten thousand shi of grain, and this was permitted.'
translations.idiomatic: Manggu Lu had already returned from a successful sea transport, and one or two southerners had volunteered to move ten thousand shi of grain, which permission was granted.

sentences.zh: 囊加<角┦>、孫萬戶復請用軍驗試海運，省院官暨眾議：「阿八失河揚用水手五千、軍五千、船千艘，畀揚州省教習漕運。

translations.literal: Nangajia Lu and Commander Sun again requested using troops to test sea transport; provincial and court officials together deliberated: 'Abahsi's river used five thousand sailors and five thousand soldiers and a thousand boats, given to Yangzhou Province to teach grain transport.
translations.idiomatic: Nangajia Lu and Commander Sun petitioned again to test sea transport with troops. Provincial and court officials jointly concluded that Abahsi's canal had employed five thousand sailors, five thousand soldiers, and a thousand boats, which Yangzhou Province had used to train grain transport crews.

sentences.zh: 今擬以此水手軍人，就用平灤船，從利津海漕運。」

translations.literal: It is now proposed to use these sailor-soldiers with Pingluan boats for grain transport from Lijin by sea.'
translations.idiomatic: It was now proposed to redeploy these sailor-soldiers with Pingluan vessels for sea transport from Lijin.

sentences.zh: 世祖從之。

translations.literal: The Emperor Shizu approved.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor approved.

sentences.zh: 阿八失所開河遂廢。

translations.literal: The river Abahsi had opened was then abandoned.
translations.idiomatic: Abahsi's canal was accordingly abandoned.

sentences.zh: 滏河滏河者，引滏水以通洺州城濠者也。

translations.literal: Fu River: the Fu River draws Fu River water to connect with the moat of Ming Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Fu Canal — a channel drawing water from the Fu River to supply the moat of Ming Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 至元五年十月，洺磁路言：「洺州城中，井泉鹹苦，居民食用，多作疾，且死者眾。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the fifth year of Zhiyuan, the Mingci Circuit reported: 'In Ming Prefecture city the wells are brackish and bitter; residents drink them, many fall ill, and deaths are numerous.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the fifth year of Zhiyuan, Mingci Circuit reported that the wells of Ming Prefecture were brackish and bitter, that residents who drank from them fell ill in great numbers, and that deaths were frequent.

sentences.zh: 請疏滌舊渠，置壩閘，引滏水分灌洺州城濠，以濟民用。

translations.literal: We request dredging the old channel, setting dams and sluices, and drawing Fu River water to irrigate the moat of Ming Prefecture to relieve civilian use.
translations.idiomatic: They asked that the old channel be dredged, dams and sluices installed, and Fu River water led into the prefectural moat to supply the people's needs.

sentences.zh: 計會河渠東西長九百步，闊六尺，深三尺，二尺為工，役工四百七十五，民自備用器，歲二次放閘，且不妨漕事。」

translations.literal: Calculated: the canal east to west 900 paces long, six feet wide, three feet deep; two feet per work unit, 475 work units; civilians provide their own tools; sluices opened twice yearly and grain transport not hindered.'
translations.idiomatic: The canal was estimated at nine hundred paces east to west, six feet wide and three feet deep, with labor reckoned at one unit per two feet for 475 units total. Civilians were to supply their own tools; the sluices would be opened twice yearly without hindering grain transport.

sentences.zh: 中書省準其言。

translations.literal: The Central Secretariat approved their report.
translations.idiomatic: The Central Secretariat approved.

sentences.zh: 廣濟渠

translations.literal: Guangji Canal
translations.idiomatic: The Guangji Canal

sentences.zh: 廣濟渠在懷孟路，引沁水以達於河。

translations.literal: The Guangji Canal is in Huaimeng Circuit, drawing Qin River water to reach the Yellow River.
translations.idiomatic: The Guangji Canal in Huaimeng Circuit drew Qin River water down to the Yellow River.

sentences.zh: 世祖中統二年，提舉王允中、大使楊端仁奉詔開河渠，凡募夫千六百五十一人，內有相合為夫者，通計使水之家六千七百餘戶，一百三十餘日工畢。

translations.literal: In the second year of Emperor Shizu's Zhongtong era, Commissioner Wang Yunzhong and Envoy Yang Duanren received an edict to open canals; laborers recruited totaled 1,651, including those combined as labor units; altogether households using the water exceeded 6,700; work was completed in 130-odd days.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of the Zhongtong era, Commissioner Wang Yunzhong and Envoy Yang Duanren received orders to open the canal, recruiting 1,651 laborers in all from more than 6,700 water-using households; the work was finished in just over 130 days.

sentences.zh: 所修石堰，長一百餘步，闊三十餘步，高一丈三尺。

translations.literal: The stone weir built was more than one hundred paces long, more than thirty paces wide, and one zhang three feet high.
translations.idiomatic: The stone weir built was over one hundred paces long, over thirty paces wide, and one zhang three feet high.

sentences.zh: 石斗門橋，高二丈，長十步，闊六步。

translations.literal: The stone sluice-gate bridge was two zhang high, ten paces long, and six paces wide.
translations.idiomatic: The stone sluice bridge stood two zhang high, ten paces long, and six paces wide.

sentences.zh: 渠四道，長闊不一，計六百七十七里，經濟源、河內、河陽、溫、武陟五縣，村坊計四百六十三處，渠成甚益於民，名曰廣濟。

translations.literal: Four channels of varying length and width, totaling 677 li, passing through Jiyuan, Henei, Heyang, Wen, and Wuzhi counties, 463 villages and wards; when the canal was completed it greatly benefited the people and was named Guangji.
translations.idiomatic: Four channels of varying dimensions totaled 677 li, passing through Jiyuan, Henei, Heyang, Wen, and Wuzhi and serving 463 villages. When completed the work greatly benefited the people and was named Guangji, "Broad Relief."

sentences.zh: 三年八月，中書省臣忽魯不花等奏：「廣濟渠司言，沁水渠成，今已驗工分水，恐久遠權豪侵奪。」

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the third year, Central Secretariat minister Hulubuhua and others memorialized: 'The Guangji Canal Office reports the Qin River canal is complete and water shares have been verified by labor; we fear that in the long run powerful families will seize and encroach.'
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the third year, Minister Hulubuhua and others reported that the Guangji Canal Office feared powerful families would in time seize the water shares now allotted after the Qin River canal's completion.

sentences.zh: 乃下詔依本司所定水分，已後諸人毋得侵奪。

translations.literal: An edict was then issued according to the water shares this office fixed; thereafter no one may encroach or seize.
translations.idiomatic: An edict was issued confirming the water allotments fixed by the office and forbidding anyone thereafter to encroach upon them.

sentences.zh: 至文宗天歷三年三月，懷慶路同知阿合馬言：「天久亢旱，夏麥枯槁，秋谷種不入土，民匱於食。

translations.literal: In the third month of the third year of Emperor Wenzong's Tianli era, Associate Administrator Ahmad of Huaqing Circuit reported: 'Heaven has long been drought-parched; summer wheat is withered; autumn grain seed cannot enter the soil; the people lack food.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the third year of the Tianli era, Associate Administrator Ahmad of Huaqing Circuit reported that prolonged drought had withered the summer wheat, autumn seed could not be sown, and the people were starving.

sentences.zh: 近因訪問耆老，咸稱丹水澆溉近山田土，居民深得其利，有沁水亦可溉田，中統間王學土亦為天旱，奉詔開此渠，募自願人戶，於太行山下沁口古跡，置分水渠口，開浚大河四道，歷溫、陟入黃河，約五百餘里，渠成名曰廣濟。

translations.literal: Recently on visiting elders, all said Dan River irrigation of nearby mountain fields deeply benefits residents; Qin River water can also irrigate fields; in Zhongtong times Academician Wang also because of drought received an edict to open this canal, recruiting voluntary households, at the ancient Qin mouth below Taihang setting a diversion mouth, opening four great channels passing Wen and Zhi to enter the Yellow River, about 500-odd li; the canal was named Guangji.
translations.idiomatic: On consulting local elders, all praised the Dan River for irrigating hillside fields. The Qin River could serve likewise. In the Zhongtong era Academician Wang, facing similar drought, had opened this canal at the ancient Qin outlet below the Taihang range, excavating four great channels through Wen and Wuzhi to the Yellow River, some five hundred li in all, and naming it Guangji.

sentences.zh: 設官提調，遇旱則官為斟酌，驗工多寡，分水澆溉，濟源、河內、河陽、溫、武陟五縣民田三千餘頃咸受其賜。

translations.literal: Officials were set to supervise; in drought the government weighed matters, verified labor amounts, divided water for irrigation; civilian fields of more than 3,000 qing in five counties all received its blessing.
translations.idiomatic: Officials were appointed to supervise; in drought they weighed water shares by labor rendered, and more than 3,000 qing of farmland in five counties benefited.

sentences.zh: 二十餘年後，因豪家截河起堰，立碾磨，壅遏水勢，又經霖雨，渠口淤塞，堤堰頹圮。

translations.literal: After more than twenty years, because powerful families cut the river and raised weirs, set up mills, and obstructed the water's force, and also because of heavy rains, the canal mouth silted and dikes and weirs collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: Within twenty years powerful families had dammed the stream for mills, choking the current; heavy rains then silted the mouth and dikes collapsed.

sentences.zh: 河渠司尋亦革罷，有司不為整治，因致廢壞。

translations.literal: The Canal Office was soon abolished as well; responsible offices did not undertake repair, and thus it fell into ruin.
translations.idiomatic: The Canal Office was soon abolished, local authorities undertook no repairs, and the works fell into ruin.

sentences.zh: 今五十餘年，分水渠口及舊渠跡，俱有可考，若蒙依前浚治，引水溉田，於民大便。

translations.literal: Now after fifty-odd years the diversion mouth and traces of the old canal can all be verified; if we may dredge and repair as before and lead water to irrigate fields, it would greatly benefit the people.
translations.idiomatic: After more than fifty years the diversion mouth and old channel can still be traced. If dredged and restored as before to irrigate the fields, the people would benefit greatly.

sentences.zh: 可令河陽、河內、濟源、溫、武陟五縣，使水人戶自備工力，疏通分水渠口，立閘起堰，仍委諳知水利之人，多方區畫。

translations.literal: Heyang, Henei, Jiyuan, Wen, and Wuzhi five counties may be ordered: water-using households provide their own labor, clear the diversion mouth, set sluices and raise weirs, and still commission persons versed in water works to plan in many ways.
translations.idiomatic: The five counties of Heyang, Henei, Jiyuan, Wen, and Wuzhi should be ordered to supply labor from water-using households to clear the diversion, install sluices and weirs, and commission men versed in hydraulics to plan the work.

sentences.zh: 遇旱，視水緩急，撤閘通流，驗工分水以灌溉；

translations.literal: In drought, viewing whether water is slow or urgent, open sluices for flow, verify labor and divide water for irrigation;
translations.idiomatic: In drought, sluices should be opened according to the water's pace, shares allotted by labor, and fields irrigated;

sentences.zh: 若霖雨泛漲，閉閘退還正流。

translations.literal: if heavy rains cause flooding, close sluices and return water to the main current.
translations.idiomatic: when heavy rains swell the river, sluices should be closed and the main current restored.

sentences.zh: 禁治不得截水置碾磨，栽種稻田。

translations.literal: Prohibition and control: one may not cut off water to set up mills or plant rice paddies.
translations.idiomatic: It should be forbidden to dam the water for mills or rice paddies.

sentences.zh: 如此，則澇旱有備，民樂趨利。

translations.literal: Thus flood and drought would have provision, and the people would gladly pursue benefit.
translations.idiomatic: Thus flood and drought would both be provided for, and the people would prosper.

sentences.zh: 請移文孟州、河內、武陟縣委官講議。」

translations.literal: We request documents sent to Mengzhou, Henei, and Wuzhi counties commissioning officials to deliberate.'
translations.idiomatic: Documents should be sent to Mengzhou, Henei, and Wuzhi to commission officials for deliberation.

sentences.zh: 尋據孟州等處申，親詣沁口，咨詢耆老，言舊日沁水正河內築土堰，遮水入廣濟渠，岸北雖有減水河道，不能吞伏，後值霖雨，蕩沒田禾，以此堵閉。

translations.literal: Soon according to reports from Mengzhou and other places, going in person to the Qin mouth and consulting elders, they said that formerly in the main Qin River an earthen weir was built to divert water into the Guangji Canal; though north of the bank there was a flood-relief channel, it could not contain the water; later heavy rains washed away fields and grain, and for this reason it was blocked shut.
translations.idiomatic: Reports from Mengzhou followed. On inspecting the Qin outlet and consulting elders, they learned that an earthen weir had once diverted the main stream into the Guangji Canal; the northern relief channel could not absorb the flood, and after heavy rains destroyed the crops the outlet had been sealed.

sentences.zh: 今若枋口上連土岸，及於沁水正河置立石堰，與枋口相平，如遇水溢，閉塞閘口，使水漫流石堰，復還本河，又從減水河分殺其勢，如此庶不為害。

translations.literal: Now if above Fangkou earthen banks are joined and at the main Qin River a stone weir is set level with Fangkou, if water overflows, close the sluice mouth so water spreads over the stone weir and returns to the main river, and again divide force from the flood-relief river—thus perhaps no harm.
translations.idiomatic: If earthen banks are joined above Fangkou and a stone weir set in the main Qin level with it, overflow can be directed over the weir back into the main channel while the relief stream splits the force—harm might thus be avoided.

sentences.zh: 約會河陽、武陟縣尹與耆老等議，若將舊廣濟渠依前開浚，減水河亦增開深闊，禁安磨碾，設立閘堰，自下使水，遇旱放閘澆田，值澇閉閘退水，公私便益。

translations.literal: Meeting Heyang and Wuzhi magistrates with elders to deliberate: if the old Guangji Canal is dredged open as before, the flood-relief river also widened and deepened, mills forbidden, sluices and weirs established, water led from below—in drought open sluices to irrigate fields, in flood close sluices to return water—public and private would both benefit.
translations.idiomatic: Heyang and Wuzhi magistrates met with elders and concluded that reopening the old Guangji Canal, widening the relief channel, forbidding mills, and installing sluices would allow irrigation in drought and safe drainage in flood, to the benefit of all.

sentences.zh: 懷慶路備申工部牒，都水監回文本路，委官相視施行。

translations.literal: Huaqing Circuit submitted in full to the Ministry of Works; the Directorate of Waterways returned documents to the circuit commissioning officials to inspect and implement.
translations.idiomatic: Huaqing Circuit reported to the Ministry of Works; the Directorate of Waterways replied directing the circuit to commission officials to inspect and carry out the work.

sentences.zh: 三白渠

translations.literal: Sanbai Canals
translations.idiomatic: The Sanbai Canals

sentences.zh: 京兆舊有三白渠，自元伐金以來，渠堰缺壞，土地荒蕪。

translations.literal: Jingzhao formerly had the Sanbai Canals; since the Yuan conquered Jin the canals and weirs have been broken and the land lies waste.
translations.idiomatic: Jingzhao once had the Sanbai Canals, but since the Yuan conquest of Jin the works had fallen into ruin and the land lay waste.

sentences.zh: 陜西之人雖欲種蒔，不獲水利，賦稅不足，軍興乏用。

translations.literal: Though the people of Shaanxi wished to plant, they could not obtain water works; tax revenue was insufficient and military campaigns lacked funds.
translations.idiomatic: Though the people of Shaanxi wished to farm, they lacked irrigation; tax revenue fell short and military campaigns went underfunded.

sentences.zh: 太宗之十二年，梁泰奏：「請差撥人戶牛具一切種蒔等物，修成渠堰，比之旱地，其收數倍，所得糧米，可以供軍。」

translations.literal: In the twelfth year of Emperor Taizong, Liang Tai memorialized: 'We request assigning households, oxen, tools, and all planting goods to repair canals and weirs; compared with dry land the harvest is several times greater, and grain obtained can supply the army.'
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year of Emperor Taizong, Liang Tai proposed assigning households, cattle, tools, and seed to restore the canals and weirs, promising several times the yield of dry land and grain enough to supply the army.

sentences.zh: 太宗準奏，就令梁泰佩元降金牌，充宣差規措三白渠使，郭時中副之，直隸朝廷，置司於雲陽縣；

translations.literal: Taizong approved the memorial and ordered Liang Tai to wear the Yuan-issued gold plaque as imperial commissioner to plan the Sanbai Canal mission, with Guo Shizhong as deputy, directly subordinate to the court, establishing an office in Yunyang County;
translations.idiomatic: Taizong approved and appointed Liang Tai, bearing the imperial gold plaque, as commissioner for the Sanbai Canals with Guo Shizhong as deputy, reporting directly to the court from an office in Yunyang County.

sentences.zh: 所用種田戶及牛畜，別降旨，付塔海紺不於軍前應副。

translations.literal: Farming households and cattle to be used were by separate edict entrusted to Tachai Gunbu at the army front to supply.
translations.idiomatic: The farming households and livestock required were by separate edict entrusted to Tachai Gunbu at the army front for supply.

sentences.zh: 是月，敕喻塔海紺不：「近梁泰奏修三白渠事，可於汝軍前所獲有妻少壯新民，量撥二千戶，及木工二十人，官牛內選肥腯齒小者一千頭，內乳牛三百，以畀梁泰等。

translations.literal: That month an edict instructed Tachai Gunbu: 'Recently Liang Tai memorialized on repairing the Sanbai Canals; from new subjects with wives and young adults captured before your army, assign about 2,000 households, twenty carpenters, and from government cattle select 1,000 fat young ones including 300 dairy cows, to give to Liang Tai and others.
translations.idiomatic: That month an edict instructed Tachai Gunbu to assign about two thousand households of captured subjects with families, twenty carpenters, and a thousand government cattle including three hundred dairy cows to Liang Tai for the Sanbai Canal project.

sentences.zh: 如不敷，於各千戶、百戶內貼補，限今歲十一月內交付數足，趁十二月入工。

translations.literal: If insufficient, supplement from each chiliarch and centurion; deadline within this year's eleventh month for full delivery, entering work in the twelfth month.
translations.idiomatic: Any shortfall was to be made up from the chiliarchs and centurions, with full delivery by the eleventh month and work to begin in the twelfth.

sentences.zh: 其耕種之人，所收之米，正為接濟軍糧。

translations.literal: The grain those who farm harvest is precisely to relieve army provisions.
translations.idiomatic: The grain harvested was to go directly to army rations.

sentences.zh: 如發遣人戶之時，或闕少衣裝，於各千戶、百戶內約量支給，差軍護送出境，沿途經過之處，亦為防送，毋致在逃走逸，驗路程給以行糧，大口一升，小者半之。」

translations.literal: When dispatching households, if clothing is lacking, provide proportionally from each chiliarch and centurion; assign soldiers to escort them beyond the border; places passed along the route shall also escort them, lest they flee; according to distance grant travel grain—adults one sheng, children half.'
translations.idiomatic: If households lacked clothing when dispatched, chiliarchs and centurions were to supply it proportionally. Soldiers were to escort them beyond the border and along the route to prevent flight. Travel rations were set at one sheng for adults and half for children according to distance.

sentences.zh: 洪口渠洪口渠在奉元路。

translations.literal: Hongkou Canal: the Hongkou Canal is in Fengyuan Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: The Hongkou Canal — located in Fengyuan Circuit.

sentences.zh: 英宗至治元年十月，陜西屯田府言：

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the first year of Emperor Yingzong's Zhizhi era, the Shaanxi Garrison Fields Office reported:
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the first year of the Zhizhi era, the Shaanxi Garrison Fields Office reported:

sentences.zh: 自秦、漢至唐、宋，年例八月差使水戶，自涇陽縣西仲山下截河築洪堰，改涇水入白渠，下至涇陽縣北白公斗門，分為三限，並平石限，蓋五縣分水之要所。

translations.literal: From Qin and Han through Tang and Song, yearly in the eighth month water households were dispatched; west of Jingyang County below Zhongshan the river was cut and the Hong weir built, turning Jing River water into the Bai Canal, down to Baigong sluice north of Jingyang, divided into three limits plus the level stone limit—the key place for dividing water among five counties.
translations.idiomatic: From Qin and Han through Tang and Song, each August water households were dispatched to cut the river below Zhongshan west of Jingyang, build the Hong weir, and divert the Jing into the Bai Canal down to Baigong sluice north of Jingyang, where three divisions and a level stone gate apportioned water among five counties.

sentences.zh: 北限入三原、櫟陽、雲陽，中限入高陵，南限入涇陽，澆溉官民田七萬餘畝。

translations.literal: The northern limit enters Sanyuan, Liyang, and Yunyang; the middle limit enters Gaoling; the southern limit enters Jingyang, irrigating more than 70,000 mu of official and civilian fields.
translations.idiomatic: The northern branch supplied Sanyuan, Liyang, and Yunyang; the middle branch Gaoling; the southern branch Jingyang—irrigating more than 70,000 mu in all.

sentences.zh: 近至大三年，陜西行臺御史王承德言，涇陽洪口展修石渠，為萬世之利。

translations.literal: Recently in the third year of Zhida, Shaanxi Branch Secretariat censor Wang Chengde said expanding the stone channel at Jingyang Hongkou would be benefit for ten thousand generations.
translations.idiomatic: Recently in the third year of Zhida, Censor Wang Chengde of the Shaanxi Branch Secretariat argued that expanding the stone channel at Jingyang Hongkou would benefit generations to come.

sentences.zh: 由是會集奉元路三原、涇陽、臨潼、高陵諸縣，洎涇陽、渭南、櫟陽諸屯官及耆老議，如準所言，展修石渠八十五步，計四百二十五尺，深二丈，廣一丈五尺，計用石十二萬七千五百尺，人日采石積方一尺，工價二兩五錢，石工二百，丁夫三百，金火匠二，用火焚水淬，日可鑿石五百尺，二百五十五日工畢。

translations.literal: Thereupon Fengyuan Circuit counties Sanyuan, Jingyang, Lintong, and Gaoling were assembled, together with garrison officers and elders of Jingyang, Weinan, and Liyang to deliberate; as approved, the stone channel was expanded eighty-five paces, 425 feet total, two zhang deep, one zhang five feet wide, requiring 127,500 cubic feet of stone; one person daily quarries one cubic foot, wage two liang five qian; 200 stonemasons, 300 corvée laborers, two gold-fire smiths; using fire to heat and water to quench, 500 feet of stone can be cut daily; work completed in 255 days.
translations.idiomatic: Officials from Sanyuan, Jingyang, Lintong, and Gaoling and garrison officers and elders of Jingyang, Weinan, and Liyang were assembled to deliberate. As approved, the stone channel was expanded eighty-five paces—425 feet long, two zhang deep, one zhang five feet wide—requiring 127,500 cubic feet of stone. Two hundred stonemasons, three hundred laborers, and two smiths using fire and water could cut five hundred feet daily; the work was to finish in 255 days.

sentences.zh: 官給其糧食用具，丁夫就役使水之家，顧匠傭直使水戶均出。

translations.literal: The government provides grain, food, and tools; corvée laborers serve water-using households; hired craftsmen's wages are equally borne by water households.
translations.idiomatic: The government supplied grain and tools; corvée laborers were drawn from water-using households, and craftsmen's wages were shared equally among them.

sentences.zh: 陜西省議，計所用錢糧，不及二年之費，可謂一勞永逸，準所言便。

translations.literal: Shaanxi Province deliberated that calculated funds and grain would not equal two years' expense—this may be called one labor, perpetual ease—and approved as proposed.
translations.idiomatic: Shaanxi Province calculated that the cost would not equal two years' expense—a true case of labor once, benefit forever—and approved the plan.

sentences.zh: 都省準委屯田府達魯花赤只裏赤督工，自延祐元年二月十日發夫匠入役，至六月十九日委官言，石性堅厚，鑿僅一丈，水泉湧出，近前續展一十七步，石積二萬五千五百尺，添夫匠百人，日鑿六百尺，二百四十二日可畢。

translations.literal: The metropolitan province approved commissioning Garrison Fields darughachi Zhilichi to supervise; from the tenth day of the second month of the first year of Yanyou laborers and craftsmen entered service; by the nineteenth day of the sixth month commissioned officials reported the stone was hard and thick, only one zhang could be cut and springs gushed forth; recently seventeen more paces were extended, stone volume 25,500 cubic feet, adding one hundred laborers and craftsmen, cutting 600 feet daily, completable in 242 days.
translations.idiomatic: The metropolitan government commissioned Garrison Fields darughachi Zhilichi to supervise. Work began on the tenth day of the second month of the first year of Yanyou. By the nineteenth day of the sixth month officials reported that the stone was so hard that only one zhang could be cut before springs burst forth. Seventeen additional paces were ordered, requiring 25,500 more cubic feet; with one hundred added workers cutting six hundred feet daily, completion was estimated in 242 days.

sentences.zh: 文宗天歷二年三月，屯田總管兼管河渠司事郭嘉議言：「去歲六月三日驟雨，涇水泛漲，無修洪堰及小龍口盡圮，水歸涇，白渠內水淺，為此計用十四萬九千五百十一工，役丁夫一千六百，度九十三日畢。
