translations.literal: In the third month of the second year of Emperor Wenzong's Tianli era, Garrison Fields commissioner and concurrent Canal Office chief Guo Jiayi reported: 'Last year on the third day of the sixth month sudden rain caused the Jing to flood; the Hong weir was not repaired and Xiaolongkou entirely collapsed; water returned to the Jing and the Bai Canal was shallow inside; for this 149,511 work units were calculated, employing 1,600 corvée laborers, estimated complete in ninety-three days.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the second year of the Tianli era, Garrison Fields Commissioner Guo Jiayi, who also oversaw canal affairs, reported that sudden rain on the third day of the sixth month last year had flooded the Jing, destroyed the Hong weir and Xiaolongkou, and left the Bai Canal shallow. Repairs would require 149,511 work units and 1,600 laborers over ninety-three days.

sentences.zh: 於使水戶內差撥，每夫就持麻一斤，鐵一斤，系囤取泥索各一，長四十尺，草苫一，長七尺，厚二寸。」

translations.literal: From among water households labor was assigned; each laborer was to carry one jin of hemp, one jin of iron, one rope for tying sacks and scooping mud forty feet long, and one straw mat seven feet long and two inches thick.'
translations.idiomatic: Labor was levied from water households, each man to bring one jin of hemp, one jin of iron, a forty-foot rope for mud baskets, and a straw mat seven feet by two inches thick.

sentences.zh: 陜西省準屯田府照，洪口自秦至宋一百二十激，經由三限，自涇陽下至臨潼五縣，分流澆溉民田七萬餘頃，驗田出夫千六百人，自八月一日修堰，至十月放水溉田，以為年例。

translations.literal: Shaanxi Province approved according to the Garrison Fields Office record: from Qin to Song Hongkou had 120 rapids, passing three limits from Jingyang down to Lintong five counties, dividing water to irrigate more than 70,000 qing of civilian fields; fields verified to supply 1,600 laborers; from the first day of the eighth month repair the weir, to the tenth month release water to irrigate fields—this is the yearly precedent.
translations.idiomatic: Shaanxi Province approved the Garrison Fields report. From Qin through Song, Hongkou's 120 rapids and three divisions supplied five counties from Jingyang to Lintong, irrigating more than 70,000 qing. Fields supplied 1,600 laborers yearly to repair the weir from the first of the eighth month and release water in the tenth month.

sentences.zh: 近因奉元亢旱，五載失稔，人皆相食，流移疫死者十七八。

translations.literal: Recently because Fengyuan suffered severe drought, five years without harvest, people ate one another, and of those who fled or died of plague seven or eight in ten.
translations.idiomatic: Fengyuan had lately suffered five years of drought; people resorted to cannibalism, and seven or eight in ten of those who fled died of plague.

sentences.zh: 今差夫又令就出用物，實不能辦集。

translations.literal: Now assigning laborers and also ordering them to provide goods on the spot, they truly cannot gather them.
translations.idiomatic: To levy laborers and require them to supply their own materials is beyond their means.

sentences.zh: 竊詳涇陽水利，雖分三限引水溉田，緣三原等縣地理遙遠，不能依時周遍，涇陽北近，俱在上限，並南限中限，用水最便。

translations.literal: I privately examine Jingyang water works: though three limits divide water for irrigation, because Sanyuan and other counties are geographically distant they cannot be served comprehensively in season; Jingyang is close to the north, all on the upper limit together with southern and middle limits—water use is most convenient.
translations.idiomatic: Jingyang's irrigation, though divided into three branches, cannot reach distant counties like Sanyuan in season. Jingyang lies nearest the headworks on the upper, southern, and middle branches and enjoys the readiest access to water.

sentences.zh: 今次修堰，除見在戶依例差役，其逃亡之家合出夫數，宜令涇陽縣近限水利戶添差一人，官日給米一升，並工修治。

translations.literal: For this weir repair, besides present households assigned by precedent, the labor quota owed by fled households should be met by adding one person from Jingyang County's nearby-limit water households, the government giving one sheng of grain daily, working together on repairs.
translations.idiomatic: For this repair, present households should serve as usual, but the quota of fled households should be met by assigning one extra man from nearby Jingyang water households, the government providing one sheng of grain daily.

sentences.zh: 省準出鈔八百錠，委耀州同知李承事，洎本府總管郭嘉議及各處正官，計工役照時直糴米給散。

translations.literal: The province approved disbursing 800 ingots of paper money, commissioning Yaozhou Associate Administrator Li Chenshi together with this prefecture's commissioner Guo Jiayi and regular officials everywhere to calculate labor and buy grain at current prices for distribution.
translations.idiomatic: The province approved eight hundred ingots of paper money and commissioned Associate Administrator Li Chenshi of Yaozhou, Commissioner Guo Jiayi, and local officials to purchase grain at current prices for the workers.

sentences.zh: 李承事督夫修築，至十一月十六日畢。

translations.literal: Li Chenshi supervised laborers in repair; completed on the sixteenth day of the eleventh month.
translations.idiomatic: Li Chenshi supervised the repairs, which were completed on the sixteenth day of the eleventh month.

sentences.zh: 揚州運河

translations.literal: Yangzhou Canal
translations.idiomatic: The Yangzhou Canal

sentences.zh: 運河在揚州之北，宋時嘗設軍疏滌，世祖取宋之後，河漸壅塞。

translations.literal: The canal is north of Yangzhou; in Song times troops were once set to dredge it; after the Emperor Shizu took Song, the river gradually silted up.
translations.idiomatic: The canal lay north of Yangzhou. Under the Song troops had once been assigned to dredge it, but after the conquest it gradually silted up.

sentences.zh: 至元末年，江淮行省嘗以為言，雖有旨浚治，有司奉行，未見實效。

translations.literal: Near the end of Zhiyuan, the Jiang-Huai Branch Secretariat once reported on it; though there was an edict to dredge and repair, responsible offices carried it out but no real effect was seen.
translations.idiomatic: Near the end of the Zhiyuan era the Jiang-Huai Branch Secretariat had raised the issue, and though dredging was ordered, responsible offices complied without visible result.

sentences.zh: 仁宗延祐四年十一月，兩淮運司言：「鹽課甚重，運河淺澀無源，止仰天雨，請加修治。」

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the fourth year of Emperor Renzong's Yanyou era, the Liang-Huai Transport Office reported: 'The salt levy is very heavy; the canal is shallow, silted, and without source, relying only on heaven's rain—we request added repair.'
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of the fourth year of the Yanyou era, the Liang-Huai Transport Office reported that the salt levy was heavy, the canal shallow and sourceless, dependent solely on rainfall, and requested repairs.

sentences.zh: 明年二月，中書移文河南省，選官洎運司有司官相視，會計工程費用。

translations.literal: The next year in the second month the Central Secretariat sent documents to Henan Province to select officials together with transport and responsible offices to inspect and calculate engineering costs.
translations.idiomatic: The following February the Central Secretariat directed Henan Province to select officials together with transport and local authorities to inspect the canal and estimate costs.

sentences.zh: 於是河南行省委都事張奉政及淮東道宣慰司官、運司官，會州縣倉場官，遍歷巡視，集議：河長二千三百五十里，有司差瀕河有田之家，顧倩丁夫，開修一千八百六十九里；

translations.literal: Thereupon Henan Branch Secretariat dispatched Secretariat Officer Zhang Fengzheng and Huaidong Pacification Commission officials and transport officials, meeting prefectural, county, and granary officials to tour and inspect; they deliberated: the river is 2,350 li long; responsible offices assign riverside landowners to hire laborers to open and repair 1,869 li;
translations.idiomatic: Henan Branch Secretariat Officer Zhang Fengzheng, Huaidong Pacification Commission and transport officials, and local granary officers toured the full length and concluded that of 2,350 li, local authorities should assign riverside landowners to hire labor for 1,869 li;

sentences.zh: 倉場鹽司不妨辦課，協濟有司，開修四百八十二里。

translations.literal: granary and salt offices, not hindering tax collection, assist responsible offices to open and repair 482 li.
translations.idiomatic: granary and salt offices, without hindering tax collection, would assist in repairing the remaining 482 li.

sentences.zh: 運司言：「近歲課額增多，而船竈戶日益貧苦，宜令有司通行修治，省減官錢。」

translations.literal: The Transport Office said: 'In recent years the tax quota has increased while boat and salt-pan households grow daily poorer; responsible offices should be ordered to repair throughout and reduce official funds.'
translations.idiomatic: The Transport Office added that tax quotas had risen while boat and salt households grew poorer, and urged comprehensive repairs with reduced official expenditure.

sentences.zh: 省臣奏準：諸色戶內顧募丁夫萬人，日支鹽糧錢二兩，計用鈔二萬錠，於運司鹽課及減駁船錢內支用。

translations.literal: Provincial ministers memorialized approval: within various households hire 10,000 laborers, daily salt-grain pay two liang, totaling 20,000 ingots of paper money, disbursed from transport salt tax and reduced boat-rejection funds.
translations.idiomatic: Provincial ministers approved hiring ten thousand laborers at two liang daily, totaling twenty thousand ingots drawn from salt revenues and reduced boat fees.

sentences.zh: 差官與都水監、河南行省、淮東宣慰司官專董其事，廉訪司體察，樞密院遣官鎮遏，乘農隙並工疏治。

translations.literal: Officials were dispatched with the Directorate of Waterways, Henan Branch Secretariat, and Huaidong Pacification Commission to specialize in supervising; the Surveillance Commission inspects; the Privy Council sends officials to suppress disturbances; taking advantage of the farming interval, work jointly to dredge and repair.
translations.idiomatic: Officials of the Directorate of Waterways, Henan Branch Secretariat, and Huaidong Pacification Commission were assigned to supervise, the Surveillance Commission to inspect, and the Privy Council to maintain order, with dredging to proceed jointly during the farming lull.

sentences.zh: 練湖在鎮江。

translations.literal: Lian Lake is in Zhenjiang.
translations.idiomatic: Lian Lake lies at Zhenjiang.

sentences.zh: 元有江南之後，豪勢之家於湖中築堤圍田耕種，侵占既廣，不足受水，遂致泛溢。

translations.literal: After the Yuan possessed Jiangnan, powerful families built dikes in the lake to enclose fields for planting; encroachment grew so wide the lake could not hold water and thus overflowed.
translations.idiomatic: After the Yuan took the south, powerful families had diked the lake for farmland until it could no longer hold water and began to overflow.

sentences.zh: 世祖末年，參政暗都剌奏請依宋例，委人提調疏治，其侵占者驗畝加賦。

translations.literal: Near the end of Emperor Shizu's reign, Participating Counselor Andulaci memorialized requesting according to Song precedent to commission persons to supervise dredging and repair, and for encroachers to be taxed by verified mu.
translations.idiomatic: Near the end of Shizu's reign, Participating Counselor Andulaci petitioned to restore Song-era supervision of dredging and to levy tax by the mu on encroached land.

sentences.zh: 至治三年十二月，省臣奏：「江浙行省言，鎮江運河全藉練湖之水為上源，官司漕運，供億京師，及商賈販載，農民來往，其舟楫莫不由此。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the third year of Zhizhi, provincial ministers memorialized: 'The Jiang-Zhe Branch Secretariat reports the Zhenjiang canal wholly relies on Lian Lake water as its upper source; official grain transport supplying the capital, merchants carrying goods, farmers coming and going—all boats pass this way.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the third year of Zhizhi, provincial ministers reported that the Jiang-Zhe Branch Secretariat had stated that the Zhenjiang canal depended entirely on Lian Lake as its source—for official grain transport to the capital, merchant traffic, and farmers alike, all boats passed this way.

sentences.zh: 宋時專設人夫，以時修浚。

translations.literal: In Song times laborers were specially assigned to dredge in season.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Song laborers had been assigned to dredge it in season.

sentences.zh: 練湖瀦蓄潦水，若運河淺阻，開放湖水一寸，則可添河水一尺。

translations.literal: Lian Lake stores flood water; if the canal is shallow and obstructed, releasing one inch of lake water can add one foot to the canal water.
translations.idiomatic: Lian Lake stored floodwater; releasing one inch of lake water could raise the canal by a foot when it ran shallow.

sentences.zh: 近年淤淺，舟楫不通，凡有官物，差民運遞，甚為不便。

translations.literal: In recent years it has silted shallow, boats cannot pass; whenever there are official goods, civilians are assigned to transport them—very inconvenient.
translations.idiomatic: In recent years silting had blocked shipping, forcing official goods to be hauled by civilians at great inconvenience.

sentences.zh: 委官相視，疏治運河，自鎮江路至呂城壩，長百三十一里，計役夫萬五百十三人，六十日可畢。

translations.literal: Officials were commissioned to inspect and dredge the canal from Zhenjiang Circuit to Lücheng Dam, 131 li long, calculated at 10,513 laborers, completable in sixty days.
translations.idiomatic: Officials were to dredge the canal from Zhenjiang to Lücheng Dam, 131 li in length, requiring 10,513 laborers over sixty days.

sentences.zh: 又用三千餘人浚滌練湖，九十日可完，人日支糧三升、中統鈔一兩。

translations.literal: Another 3,000-odd persons to dredge Lian Lake, completable in ninety days, each person daily three sheng grain and one liang Zhongtong paper money.
translations.idiomatic: More than three thousand additional workers would dredge Lian Lake in ninety days, each receiving three sheng of grain and one liang of Zhongtong paper money daily.

sentences.zh: 行省、行臺分官監督。

translations.literal: Branch Secretariat and Branch Secretariat Censorate officials separately supervised.
translations.idiomatic: Branch Secretariat and Censorate officials were to supervise separately.

sentences.zh: 所用船物，今歲預備，來春興工。

translations.literal: Boats and materials to be used are prepared this year; work begins next spring.
translations.idiomatic: Boats and materials were to be prepared this year and work begun the following spring.

sentences.zh: 合行事宜，依江浙行省所擬。」

translations.literal: Matters to be carried out follow what the Jiang-Zhe Branch Secretariat proposed.'
translations.idiomatic: The plan was approved as proposed by the Jiang-Zhe Branch Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 既得旨，都省移文江浙行省，委參政董中奉率合屬正官親臨督役。

translations.literal: Once the edict was received, the metropolitan province sent documents to the Jiang-Zhe Branch Secretariat, commissioning Participating Counselor Dong Zhongfeng to lead all subordinate regular officials to supervise in person.
translations.idiomatic: Once approved, the metropolitan government directed the Jiang-Zhe Branch Secretariat to commission Participating Counselor Dong Zhongfeng to supervise the work in person with all responsible officials.

sentences.zh: 於是董中奉言：「所委前都水少監崇明州知州任奉政、鎮江路總管毛中議等議：練湖、運河此非一事，宜依假山諸湖農民取泥之法，用船千艘，船三人，用竹褷撈取淤泥，日可三載，月計九萬載，三月之間，通取二十七萬載，就用所取泥增築湖岸。

translations.literal: Thereupon Dong Zhongfeng reported: 'Those commissioned—former Deputy Director of Waterways and Chongming Prefecture magistrate Ren Fengzheng, Zhenjiang Circuit commissioner Mao Zhongyi, and others—deliberated: Lian Lake and the canal are not one matter; it is fitting to follow the method of Jiaoshan and other lakes where farmers take mud, using 1,000 boats, three persons per boat, using bamboo scoops to dredge silt; three loads daily, 90,000 loads monthly, in three months 270,000 loads total, using the mud taken to heighten the lake bank.
translations.idiomatic: Dong Zhongfeng reported that Ren Fengzheng, former deputy director of waterways and magistrate of Chongming, Mao Zhongyi, commissioner of Zhenjiang, and others had concluded that lake and canal were separate tasks. Following the Jiaoshan method, one thousand boats with three men each using bamboo scoops could dredge three loads daily—270,000 loads in three months—to raise the lake banks with the silt removed.

sentences.zh: 自鎮江在城程公壩，至常州武進縣呂城壩，河長百三十一里一百四十六步，擬開河面闊五丈，底闊三丈，深四尺，與見有水二尺，可積深六尺。

translations.literal: From Zhenjiang in-city Chenggong Dam to Changzhou Wujin County Lücheng Dam, the river is 131 li 146 paces long; proposed to open surface width five zhang, bottom width three zhang, depth four feet; with present water two feet, accumulated depth can be six feet.
translations.idiomatic: From Chenggong Dam in Zhenjiang city to Lücheng Dam in Wujin County, Changzhou, the canal ran 131 li and 146 paces. The plan called for a surface five zhang wide, a bottom three zhang wide, and four feet of new depth added to the existing two feet for six feet total.

sentences.zh: 所役夫於平江、鎮江、常州、江陰州及建康路所轄溧陽州田多上戶內差倩。

translations.literal: Laborers were to be assigned from among major landholding households in Pingjiang, Zhenjiang, Changzhou, Jiangyin Prefecture, and Liyang Prefecture under Jiankang Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Labor was to be levied from major landholding households in Pingjiang, Zhenjiang, Changzhou, Jiangyin, and Liyang under Jiankang Circuit.

sentences.zh: 若浚湖開河，二役並興，卒難辦集。

translations.literal: If dredging the lake and opening the river, both tasks arise together, it is hard to gather labor at once.
translations.idiomatic: To dredge the lake and open the canal simultaneously would be beyond immediate capacity.

sentences.zh: 宜趁農隙，先開運河，工畢就浚練湖。」

translations.literal: It is fitting to take advantage of the farming interval, first open the canal, and when work is done then dredge Lian Lake.'
translations.idiomatic: During the farming lull the canal should be opened first, and Lian Lake dredged only after that work was finished.

sentences.zh: 省準所言，與都事王徵事等於泰定元年正月至鎮江丹陽縣，洎各監工官沿湖相視，上湖沙岡黃土，下湖茭根叢雜，泥亦堅硬，不可褷取。

translations.literal: The provincial court approved what was stated, and together with Bureau of General Affairs Wang Zhengshi and others, in the first month of the first year of the Zhiding era went to Danyang County in Zhenjiang; together with each supervising work official they inspected along the lake—the upper lake had sandy ridges and yellow earth, the lower lake had dense intermixed rush roots, and the mud was also hard and could not be scooped out.
translations.idiomatic: The provincial court approved the report, and Wang Zhengshi of the Bureau of General Affairs and others went to Danyang County, Zhenjiang, in the first month of Zhiding 1 to inspect the lake with the supervising officials. They found sandy ridges and yellow soil in the upper lake and dense rush roots in the lower lake—the mud was too hard to scoop.

sentences.zh: 又議兩役並興，相離三百餘里，往來監督，供給為難，願以所督夫一萬三千五百十二人，先開運河，期四十七日畢，次浚練湖，二十日可完。

translations.literal: They also deliberated that if both tasks were undertaken together, being more than three hundred li apart, going back and forth to supervise and supply provisions would be difficult; they wished to use the 13,512 laborers under supervision to open the canal first, expecting completion in forty-seven days, and then dredge Lian Lake, which could be finished in twenty days.
translations.idiomatic: They also argued that running both projects at once would be impractical—the sites were more than three hundred li apart, making supervision and supplies difficult. They proposed using their 13,512 laborers to open the canal first within forty-seven days, then dredge Lian Lake in twenty.

sentences.zh: 繼有江南行臺侍御史及浙西廉訪司副使俱至，乃議首事運河，備文咨稟，遂於是月十七日入役。

translations.literal: Subsequently the censor of the Jiangnan Branch Secretariat and the vice commissioner of the Zhexi Surveillance Commission both arrived; they then deliberated to begin with the canal, prepared documents for consultation and report, and on the seventeenth day of that month labor entered service.
translations.idiomatic: The Jiangnan Branch Secretariat censor and the Zhexi Surveillance vice commissioner then arrived, agreed to start with the canal, prepared the necessary reports, and put laborers to work on the seventeenth of that month.

sentences.zh: 二月十八日，省臣奏：「開浚運河、練湖，重役也，宜依行省所議，仍令便宜從事。」

translations.literal: On the eighteenth day of the second month, provincial officials memorialized: "Opening and dredging the canal and Lian Lake is heavy work; it is fitting to follow what the branch secretariat deliberated, and still permit acting at convenience."
translations.idiomatic: On the eighteenth of the second month, provincial officials memorialized that opening the canal and dredging Lian Lake was major work and should proceed as the branch secretariat had proposed, with officials authorized to act as circumstances required.

sentences.zh: 後各監工官言：「已分運河作三壩，依元料深闊丈尺開浚，至三月四日工畢。

translations.literal: Later each supervising work official reported: "The canal has already been divided into three sections; dredging proceeded according to the original specifications for depth and width; work was completed on the fourth day of the third month.
translations.idiomatic: The supervising officials later reported that the canal had been divided into three sections and dredged to the original depth and width specifications, with work finished on the fourth of the third month.

sentences.zh: 數內平江昆山、嘉定二州，實役二十六日，常熟、吳江二州，長洲、吳縣，實役二十八日，餘皆役三十日，已於三月七日積水行舟。」

translations.literal: Within the count, Pingjiang's Kunshan and Jiading prefectures actually worked twenty-six days; Changshu and Wujiang prefectures, Changzhou and Wu counties, actually worked twenty-eight days; the rest all worked thirty days; by the seventh day of the third month water had accumulated and boats could travel."
translations.idiomatic: Within the totals, Kunshan and Jiading in Pingjiang actually worked twenty-six days; Changshu, Wujiang, Changzhou, and Wu worked twenty-eight; all others worked thirty. By the seventh of the third month enough water had accumulated for boats to pass.

sentences.zh: 又監修練湖官言：「任奉議指劃元料，增築堤堰及舊有土基，共增闊一丈二尺，平面至高底灘腳，增築共量斜高二丈五尺。

translations.literal: The officials supervising Lian Lake repairs also reported: "Following Councillor Ren's layout of the original specifications, dikes and existing earthen foundations were heightened and widened—a total added width of one zhang and two feet; measured from the flat surface to the lower beach toe, the added construction totals a sloped height of two zhang and five feet.
translations.idiomatic: The Lian Lake supervisors reported that, following Councillor Ren's original plan, dikes and existing foundations were raised and widened by one zhang and two feet, with a total sloped height of two zhang and five feet from the flat crest to the lower beach toe.

sentences.zh: 依中堰西石䃮東舊堤臥羊灘修築，如舊堤高闊已及所料之上者，遇有崩缺，修築令完。

translations.literal: Construction followed the old dike from the stone sluice west of the middle weir eastward to Woyang Beach; where existing dikes already met or exceeded the specifications in height and width, any breaches were repaired to completion.
translations.idiomatic: Work proceeded along the old dike from the stone sluice west of the middle weir east to Woyang Beach. Where existing dikes already met or exceeded the planned height and width, any breaches were repaired.

sentences.zh: 中堰西石䃮至五百婆堤西上增高土一尺，有缺亦補之。

translations.literal: From the stone sluice west of the middle weir to Wubai Po Dike, one foot of earth was added on the west side; gaps were also filled in.
translations.idiomatic: From the stone sluice west of the middle weir to Wubai Po Dike, one foot of earth was added on the west side, and any gaps were filled.

sentences.zh: 五百婆堤至馬林橋堤水勢稍緩，不須修治，其堤底間有滲漏者，窒塞之。

translations.literal: From Wubai Po Dike to Malin Bridge Dike the water force was somewhat slower and did not require repair; where the dike base had seepage, it was plugged.
translations.idiomatic: From Wubai Po Dike to Malin Bridge Dike the current was mild enough that no major repairs were needed; seepage at the dike base was plugged where it occurred.

sentences.zh: 三月六日破土，九日入役，至十一日工畢，實役三日。

translations.literal: On the sixth day of the third month ground was broken; labor entered service on the ninth; work was completed on the eleventh—three days of actual labor.
translations.idiomatic: Ground was broken on the sixth of the third month, labor began on the ninth, and work was finished on the eleventh—three days of actual service.

sentences.zh: 歸勘任少監元料，開運河夫萬五百十三人，六十日畢，浚練湖夫三千人，九十日畢，人日支鈔一兩、米三升，共該鈔萬八千一十四錠二十兩，米二萬七千二十一石六斗，實征夫萬三千五百十二人，共役三十三日，支鈔八千六百七十九錠三十六兩，糧萬三千十九石五斗八升。

translations.literal: When cross-checked against Deputy Director Ren's original estimates: canal laborers 10,513 men, sixty days to finish; Lian Lake dredgers 3,000 men, ninety days to finish; each person daily one liang of paper money and three sheng of rice; total due 18,014 ingots 20 liang of paper money and 27,021 shi 6 dou of rice; actually conscripted 13,512 men, total service thirty-three days, paid 8,679 ingots 36 liang, grain 13,019 shi 5 dou 8 sheng.
translations.idiomatic: Cross-checked against Deputy Director Ren's original estimates—10,513 men for sixty days on the canal and 3,000 men for ninety days on Lian Lake, at one liang of paper money and three sheng of rice per person per day—the projected cost was 18,014 ingots 20 liang and 27,021 shi 6 dou of rice. In fact 13,512 men served thirty-three days at a cost of 8,679 ingots 36 liang and 13,019 shi 5 dou 8 sheng of grain.

sentences.zh: 比附元料，省鈔九千三百三十四錠三十四兩，糧萬四千二石二升。

translations.literal: Compared with the original estimates, paper money saved 9,334 ingots 34 liang, grain saved 14,002 shi 2 sheng.
translations.idiomatic: Compared with the original estimates, the project saved 9,334 ingots 34 liang in paper money and 14,002 shi 2 sheng of grain.

sentences.zh: 其練湖未畢，相視地形水勢再議。」

translations.literal: As for Lian Lake not yet finished, they inspected the terrain and water conditions and deliberated again."
translations.idiomatic: Because Lian Lake work was not yet complete, they inspected the terrain and water conditions for further deliberation."

sentences.zh: 參政董中奉又言：「練湖舊有湖兵四十三人，添補五十七名，共百人，於本路州縣苗糧三石之下、二石之上差充，專任修築湖岸，設提領二員、壕寨二人、司吏三人，於有出身人內選用。」

translations.literal: Participating Minister Dong Zhongfeng also stated: "Lian Lake originally had forty-three lake soldiers; fifty-seven names were added, totaling one hundred; from households in this circuit's prefectures and counties with grain tax between two and three shi they were assigned, dedicated solely to repairing the lake banks; two supervisors, two trench wardens, and three clerks were established, selected from persons with official background."
translations.idiomatic: Participating Minister Dong Zhongfeng also proposed staffing Lian Lake with one hundred lake soldiers—forty-three existing plus fifty-seven new recruits drawn from households paying between two and three shi in grain tax. They would be dedicated to repairing the lake banks, with two supervisors, two trench wardens, and three clerks chosen from men of official background.

sentences.zh: 工部議：「練湖所設提領人等印信，即同湖兵，宜咨本省遍行議擬。」

translations.literal: The Ministry of Works deliberated: "The seals for the supervisors and others established at Lian Lake are the same as for lake soldiers; the provincial office should be consulted for widespread deliberation and planning."
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Works replied that the seals issued to Lian Lake supervisors should be treated like those of lake soldiers, and the provincial office should be consulted for a province-wide plan.

sentences.zh: 又鎮江路言：「河、練湖今已開浚，若不設法關防，徒勞民力。

translations.literal: Zhenjiang Circuit also stated: "The canal and Lian Lake have now been opened and dredged; if protective measures are not established, the people's labor will have been wasted in vain.
translations.idiomatic: Zhenjiang Circuit also warned that with the canal and Lian Lake now dredged, failure to establish safeguards would waste all the labor already expended.

sentences.zh: 除關本路達魯花赤兀魯失海牙總治其事，同知哈散、知事程郇專管啟閉斗門。」

translations.literal: Besides having this circuit's darughachi Urus Haiya overall manage the matter, Deputy Commissioner Hasan and Bureau Chief Cheng Xun were specifically charged with opening and closing the sluice gates."
translations.idiomatic: The circuit darughachi Urus Haiya was to oversee the work overall, while Deputy Commissioner Hasan and Bureau Chief Cheng Xun were assigned specifically to operate the sluice gates.

sentences.zh: 行省從之。

translations.literal: The branch secretariat approved.
translations.idiomatic: The branch secretariat approved.

sentences.zh: 吳松江

translations.literal: Wusong River
translations.idiomatic: Wusong River

sentences.zh: 浙西諸山之水受之太湖，下為吳松江，東匯澱山湖以入海，而潮汐來往，逆湧濁沙，上涇河口，是以宋時設置撩洗軍人，專掌修治。

translations.literal: The waters of the various mountains of western Zhejiang are received into Tai Lake, descend as the Wusong River, and converge east at Dianshan Lake to enter the sea; but tides come and go, surging muddy sand back up into the river mouth—hence in Song times dredging troops were established, dedicated solely to repair and maintenance.
translations.idiomatic: The waters of western Zhejiang's mountains flow into Tai Lake and down the Wusong River, gathering at Dianshan Lake before reaching the sea. Tidal action constantly drives muddy sand back up the river mouth, which is why the Song had established dredging troops to maintain the channel.

sentences.zh: 元既平宋，軍士罷散，有司不以為務，勢豪租占為蕩為田，州縣不得其人，輒行許準，以致湮塞不通，公私俱失其利久矣。

translations.literal: After the Yuan had pacified the Song, the troops were disbanded; the responsible officials did not treat it as their task; powerful families rented and occupied the marshes as farmland; the prefectures and counties could not obtain suitable persons and rashly granted approval—so that siltation and blockage persisted for long, and both public and private interests lost their benefit.
translations.idiomatic: After the Yuan conquered the Song, the dredging troops were disbanded and officials neglected the river. Powerful families leased and reclaimed the marshes as farmland, and local governments, lacking qualified staff, approved the encroachments anyway. The channel silted shut, and public and private interests alike suffered for years.

sentences.zh: 至治三年，江浙省臣方以為言，就委嘉興路治中高朝列、湖州路知事丁將仕同本處正官，體究舊曾疏浚通海故道，及新生沙漲礙水處所，商度開滌圖呈。

translations.literal: In the third year of the Zhizhi era, Zhejiang branch officials had just raised the matter; they thereupon commissioned Jiaxing Circuit chief administrator Gao Chaolie and Huzhou Circuit bureau chief Ding Jiangshi, together with local regular officials, to investigate the old dredged routes to the sea and newly formed sand bars obstructing the water, deliberate on dredging, and submit a map.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhizhi 3, Zhejiang officials raised the issue and commissioned Gao Chaolie, chief administrator of Jiaxing, and Ding Jiangshi, bureau chief of Huzhou, together with local officials, to survey the old sea outlet channels and new sand bars blocking the flow, plan dredging work, and submit a map.

sentences.zh: 據丁知事等官按視講究，合開浚河道五十五處。

translations.literal: According to Magistrate Ding and other officials' on-site inspection and investigation, fifty-five places in total required channel dredging.
translations.idiomatic: On inspection, Magistrate Ding and his colleagues determined that fifty-five stretches of channel needed dredging.

sentences.zh: 內常熟州九處，十三段，該工百三十二萬一千五百六十二，昆山州十一處，九十五里，用工二萬七千四百，役夫四百五十六，宜於本州有田一頃之上戶內，驗田多寡，算量裏步均派，自備糧赴功疏浚。

translations.literal: Within this: Changshu Prefecture nine places, thirteen segments, work totaling 1,321,562; Kunshan Prefecture eleven places, ninety-five li, labor 27,400, corvée laborers 456—it is fitting that from major households in this prefecture holding one qing of land or more, according to the amount of land, calculating and distributing by li and pace, they should self-supply grain and come to work for dredging.
translations.idiomatic: Changshu had nine sites in thirteen segments requiring 1,321,562 units of work. Kunshan had eleven sites over ninety-five li, needing 27,400 labor units and 456 corvée workers. Households in each prefecture holding at least one qing of land should be assessed by acreage, assigned work proportionally, and supply their own rations for dredging.

sentences.zh: 正月上旬興工，限六十日工畢，二年一次舉行。

translations.literal: Work was to begin in the first ten days of the first month, with a limit of sixty days for completion, conducted once every two years.
translations.idiomatic: Work was to start in early first month, finish within sixty days, and repeat every two years.

sentences.zh: 嘉定州三十五處，五百三十八里，該工百二十六萬七千五十九，日支糧一升，計米萬二千六百七十石五斗九升，日役夫二萬一千一百一十七，六十日畢。

translations.literal: Jiading Prefecture thirty-five places, five hundred thirty-eight li, work totaling 1,267,059; daily grain one sheng per person, totaling rice 12,670 shi 5 dou 9 sheng; daily corvée laborers 21,117; completion in sixty days.
translations.idiomatic: Jiading had thirty-five sites over five hundred thirty-eight li, requiring 1,267,059 units of work. At one sheng of grain per person per day—12,670 shi 5 dou 9 sheng of rice in all—and 21,117 daily laborers, the project could be finished in sixty days.

sentences.zh: 工程浩大，米糧數多，乞依年例，勸率附河有田用水之家，自備口糧，佃戶傭力開浚。

translations.literal: The project was vast and the rice numbers great; they requested following the annual precedent, urging and leading river-adjacent landholding households that use the water to self-supply rations, with tenant farmers hired for labor to dredge.
translations.idiomatic: Because the project was enormous and the grain requirement heavy, they asked to follow the usual practice of urging riverside landowners who depended on the water to supply their own rations while tenants provided the labor for dredging.

sentences.zh: 奈本州連年被災，今歲尤甚，力有不逮，宜從上司區處。

translations.literal: But this prefecture had suffered disasters for consecutive years, and this year was especially severe; its strength was insufficient to meet the demand—it was fitting to seek disposition from superiors.
translations.idiomatic: But Jiading had suffered disasters year after year, and this year was worse than ever; local capacity was insufficient, and higher authorities would need to arrange relief.

sentences.zh: 高治中會集松江府各州縣官按視，議合浚河渠，華亭縣九處，計五百二十八里，該工九百六十八萬四千八百八十二，役夫十六萬一千四百一十四，人日支糧二升，計米十九萬三千六百九十七石六斗四升。

translations.literal: Chief Administrator Gao convened officials of each prefecture and county of Songjiang Prefecture for on-site inspection and agreed to dredge channels: Huating County nine places, totaling five hundred twenty-eight li, work 9,684,882, corvée laborers 161,414, each person daily two sheng of grain, totaling rice 193,697 shi 6 dou 4 sheng.
translations.idiomatic: Chief Administrator Gao gathered Songjiang officials for inspection and agreed to dredge the channels. Huating County alone had nine sites over five hundred twenty-eight li, requiring 9,684,882 units of work, 161,414 laborers at two sheng of grain per person per day—193,697 shi 6 dou 4 sheng of rice in all.

sentences.zh: 上海縣十四處，計四百七十一里，該工千二百三十六萬八千五十二，日役夫二萬六千一百三十四，人日支糧二升，計二十四萬七千三百六十一石四升，六十日工畢。

translations.literal: Shanghai County fourteen places, totaling four hundred seventy-one li, work 12,368,052, daily corvée laborers 26,134, each person daily two sheng of grain, totaling 247,361 shi 4 sheng, work completed in sixty days.
translations.idiomatic: Shanghai County had fourteen sites over four hundred seventy-one li, requiring 12,368,052 units of work. With 26,134 daily laborers at two sheng of grain each—247,361 shi 4 sheng in all—the work could be finished in sixty days.

sentences.zh: 官給之糧，傭民疏治。

translations.literal: Grain supplied by the government; commoners hired for dredging treatment.
translations.idiomatic: The government would supply grain and hire common laborers to do the dredging.

sentences.zh: 如下年豐稔，勸率有田之家，五十畝出夫一人，十畝之上驗數合出，止於本保開浚。

translations.literal: If the following year brought abundant harvest, landholding families were to be urged and led: fifty mu provide one laborer; above ten mu the number due was calculated proportionally; dredging was limited to one's local ward.
translations.idiomatic: If the next year brought a good harvest, landowners would be urged to contribute one laborer per fifty mu of land, with proportional assignments above ten mu, limited to dredging within their own ward.

sentences.zh: 其權勢之家，置立魚斷並沙塗栽葦者，依上出夫。

translations.literal: Powerful families who set up fish weirs and planted reeds on tidal flats were likewise required to provide laborers as above.
translations.idiomatic: Powerful families who maintained fish weirs or planted reeds on tidal flats would be subject to the same labor obligations.

sentences.zh: 其上海、嘉定連年旱澇，皆緣河口湮塞，旱則無以灌溉，澇則不能疏泄，累致凶歉，官民俱病。

translations.literal: Shanghai and Jiading had suffered drought and flood for consecutive years, all because the river mouth was silted shut—during drought there was no means to irrigate, during flood no means to drain; repeatedly causing famine, afflicting both officials and people.
translations.idiomatic: Shanghai and Jiading had suffered drought and flood year after year because the river mouth was blocked. In drought they could not irrigate; in flood they could not drain. Famine followed repeatedly, harming officials and commoners alike.

sentences.zh: 至元三十年以後，兩經疏辟，稍得豐稔。

translations.literal: After the thirtieth year of the Zhiyuan era, dredging was conducted twice, and somewhat abundant harvests were obtained.
translations.idiomatic: After Zhiyuan 30 the channels were dredged twice, and harvests improved somewhat.

sentences.zh: 比年又復壅閉，勢家愈加租占，雖得征賦，實失大利。

translations.literal: In recent years it had again become blocked; powerful families increasingly rented and occupied land; though tax revenue was collected, in reality great benefit was lost.
translations.idiomatic: In recent years the channels had silted shut again as powerful families encroached further. Tax revenue continued, but the region's larger economic gains were lost.

sentences.zh: 上海縣歲收官糧一十七萬石，民糧三萬餘石，略舉似延祐七年災傷五萬八千七百餘石，至治元年災傷四萬九千餘石，二年十萬七千餘石，水旱連年，殆無虛歲，不惟虧欠官糧，復有賑貸之費。

translations.literal: Shanghai County yearly collected official grain 170,000 shi, civilian grain more than 30,000 shi—for example, in the seventh year of Yanyou disaster losses 58,700-odd shi; in the first year of Zhizhi disaster losses 49,000-odd shi; in the second year 107,000-odd shi; drought and flood for consecutive years, scarcely a year without disaster—not only shortfalls in official grain, but also relief and loan expenses.
translations.idiomatic: Shanghai County collected 170,000 shi in official grain and over 30,000 shi in civilian grain annually. Disaster losses alone totaled more than 58,700 shi in Yanyou 7, nearly 49,000 shi in Zhizhi 1, and over 107,000 shi in Zhizhi 2. Drought and flood struck almost every year, leaving official grain short and forcing costly relief efforts.

sentences.zh: 近委官相視地形，講議疏浚，其通海大江，未易遽治；

translations.literal: Recently officials were commissioned to inspect the terrain and discuss dredging; the great river reaching the sea was not easy to treat quickly;
translations.idiomatic: Officials had recently been sent to survey the terrain and discuss dredging, but the main river to the sea could not be remedied quickly;

sentences.zh: 舊有河港聯絡官民田土之間、藉以灌溉者，今皆填塞，必須疏通，以利耕種。

translations.literal: the old channels linking official and civilian farmland and relied upon for irrigation were now all filled in—they must be cleared to benefit cultivation.
translations.idiomatic: the old irrigation channels linking public and private farmland were now filled in and would have to be cleared to restore farming.

sentences.zh: 欲令有田人戶自為開浚，而工役浩繁，民力不能獨成。

translations.literal: They wished to have landholding households dredge on their own, but the labor was vast and the people's strength could not accomplish it alone.
translations.idiomatic: They wanted landowners to dredge the channels themselves, but the work was too extensive for local communities to manage alone.

sentences.zh: 由是議，上海、嘉定河港，宜令本處所管軍民站竈僧道諸色有田者，以多寡出夫，自備糧修治，州縣正官督役。

translations.literal: Therefore it was deliberated: for Shanghai and Jiading channels, it was fitting to order military and civilian households, postal stations, salt works, monks, Taoists, and all categories with land under local jurisdiction to provide laborers according to amount of land, self-supply grain for repair, with prefecture and county regular officials supervising the work.
translations.idiomatic: They therefore proposed that Shanghai and Jiading channels be repaired by all local landholders—soldiers, civilians, postal workers, salt producers, monks, and Taoists alike—contributing labor in proportion to their holdings, supplying their own rations, under supervision by prefecture and county officials.

sentences.zh: 其豪勢租占蕩田、妨水利者，並與除辟。

translations.literal: Powerful families' rented and occupied marshland that obstructed water control were all to be cleared and reclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: Encroachments by powerful families on marshland that blocked water flow were to be cleared as well.

sentences.zh: 本處民田稅糧全免一年，官租減半。

translations.literal: Local civilian land tax grain was fully exempted for one year; official rent was reduced by half.
translations.idiomatic: Local civilian land tax would be fully waived for one year, and official rent cut by half.

sentences.zh: 今秋收成，下年農隙舉行，行省、行臺、廉訪司官巡鎮。

translations.literal: After this autumn's harvest, work was to be conducted during the next year's farming interval, with branch secretariat, branch censorate, and surveillance commission officials patrolling and overseeing.
translations.idiomatic: Work would begin after the autumn harvest during the next year's farming lull, with branch secretariat, censorate, and surveillance officials overseeing it.

sentences.zh: 外據華亭、昆山、常熟州河港，比上海、嘉定緩急不同，難為一體，從各處勸農正官督有田之家，備糧並工修治。

translations.literal: Besides, according to the channels of Huating, Kunshan, and Changshu prefectures, compared with Shanghai and Jiading the urgency differed and could not be treated as one unit; each locality's agriculture-promoting regular officials were to supervise landholding families to supply grain and join labor for repair.
translations.idiomatic: Huating, Kunshan, and Changshu presented a different level of urgency from Shanghai and Jiading and could not be handled uniformly. In each place, agriculture officials would supervise landowners supplying grain and labor for repairs.

sentences.zh: 若遽興工，陰陽家言癸亥年動土有忌，預為咨稟可否。

translations.literal: If work were hastily begun, yin-yang masters said that in the guihai year breaking earth had taboos; they requested advance consultation on whether it was permissible.
translations.idiomatic: If work began too soon, geomancers warned that breaking ground in a guihai year was inauspicious, and asked whether advance approval could be sought.

sentences.zh: 至泰定元年十月十九日，右丞相旭邁傑等奏：「江浙省言，吳松江等處河道壅塞，宜為疏滌，仍立閘以節水勢。

translations.literal: On the nineteenth day of the tenth month of the first year of the Zhiding era, Right Chancellor Xu Maijie and others memorialized: "The Zhejiang branch secretariat states that channels at Wusong River and other places are silted shut; dredging is appropriate, and sluice gates should still be established to regulate the water force.
translations.idiomatic: On the nineteenth of the tenth month of Zhiding 1, Right Chancellor Xu Maijie and others reported that Zhejiang officials had stated the Wusong River and other channels were blocked and should be dredged, with sluice gates built to control the flow.

sentences.zh: 計用四萬餘人，今歲十二月為始，至正月終，六十日可畢，用二萬餘人，二年可畢。

translations.literal: Estimated use of more than forty thousand men; starting from the twelfth month of this year to the end of the first month, sixty days could complete it; using more than twenty thousand men, two years could complete it.
translations.idiomatic: The project would require more than forty thousand men. Starting in the twelfth month and finishing by the end of the first month, it could be done in sixty days; with more than twenty thousand men, it would take two years.

sentences.zh: 其丁夫於旁郡諸色戶內均差，依練湖例，給傭直糧食，行省、行臺、廉訪司並有司官同提調。

translations.literal: Corvée laborers were to be evenly assigned from various categories of households in neighboring prefectures; following the Lian Lake precedent, wages and grain were to be supplied; branch secretariat, branch censorate, surveillance commission, and local officials were jointly to supervise.
translations.idiomatic: Corvée labor would be levied evenly from various household categories in neighboring prefectures, with wages and grain paid as at Lian Lake, under joint supervision by branch secretariat, censorate, surveillance, and local officials.

sentences.zh: 臣等議，此事官民兩便，宜從其請。

translations.literal: We deliberated: this matter benefits both officials and people; their request should be granted.
translations.idiomatic: We concluded that the proposal served both government and people and should be approved.

sentences.zh: 若丁夫有餘，止令一年畢。

translations.literal: If corvée laborers were surplus, require only one year for completion.
translations.idiomatic: If enough laborers were available, the work could be finished in a single year.

sentences.zh: 命脫歡答剌罕諸臣同提調，專委左丞朵兒只班及前都水任少監董役。」

translations.literal: Toqan Taghai and the ministers were ordered to supervise jointly; Left Chancellor Duorzhiban and former Deputy Director of Waterways Ren were specially commissioned to manage the work."
translations.idiomatic: Toqan Taghai and other ministers were ordered to supervise the project jointly, with Left Chancellor Duorzhiban and former Deputy Director of Waterways Ren placed in direct charge.

sentences.zh: 得旨，移文行省，準擬疏治。

translations.literal: Receiving the decree, a document was sent to the branch secretariat approving dredging treatment.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved, and orders were sent to the branch secretariat to proceed with dredging.

sentences.zh: 江浙省下各路發夫入役，至二年閏正月四日工畢。

translations.literal: The Zhejiang branch secretariat sent labor from each circuit into service; work was completed on the fourth day of the intercalary first month of the second year.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhejiang branch secretariat mobilized labor from every circuit, and work was finished on the fourth of the intercalary first month in the second year.

sentences.zh: 澱山湖

translations.literal: Dianshan Lake
translations.idiomatic: Dianshan Lake

sentences.zh: 太湖為浙西巨浸，上受杭、湖諸山之水，瀦蓄之余，分匯為澱山湖，東流入海。

translations.literal: Tai Lake is the great flood basin of western Zhejiang; above it receives the waters of the Hang and Hu mountains; after impounding, the overflow divides and converges as Dianshan Lake, flowing east to enter the sea.
translations.idiomatic: Tai Lake was western Zhejiang's great reservoir, fed by the mountains of Hangzhou and Huzhou. Its overflow gathered in Dianshan Lake before flowing east to the sea.

sentences.zh: 世祖末年，參政暗都剌言：「此湖在宋時委官差軍守之，湖旁余地，不許侵占，常疏其壅塞，以泄水勢。

translations.literal: In the final years of Emperor Shizu, Participating Minister Andula stated: "This lake in Song times had appointed officials and dispatched troops to guard it; marginal land beside the lake was not permitted to be encroached upon; blockages were regularly dredged to release the water force.
translations.idiomatic: Near the end of Kublai's reign, Participating Minister Andula reported that in Song times officials and troops had guarded the lake, encroachment on its margins was forbidden, and blockages were cleared regularly to release floodwater.

sentences.zh: 今既無人管領，遂為勢豪絕水築堤，繞湖為田，湖狹不足瀦蓄，每遇霖潦，泛溢為害。

translations.literal: Now with no one in charge, it became powerful families cutting off water and building dikes, encircling the lake as farmland; the lake grew too narrow to impound sufficiently—whenever heavy rains came, it overflowed as harm.
translations.idiomatic: With no one in charge, powerful families had dammed the outflow and reclaimed land around the lake. The lake grew too narrow to hold floodwater, and heavy rains now caused widespread overflow.

sentences.zh: 昨本省官忙古<角┦>等興言疏治，因受曹總管金而止。

translations.literal: Previously provincial officials Mangulu and others raised the matter of dredging treatment, but stopped because they received gold from Commissioner Cao.
translations.idiomatic: Provincial officials including Mangulu had proposed dredging, but the effort stopped after Commissioner Cao paid them off.

sentences.zh: 張參議、潘應武等相繼建言，識者咸以為便。

translations.literal: Participating Councillor Zhang, Pan Yingwu, and others successively memorialized; those with knowledge all considered it convenient.
translations.idiomatic: Participating Councillor Zhang, Pan Yingwu, and others memorialized in turn, and informed opinion agreed the project was worthwhile.

sentences.zh: 臣等議，此事可行無疑。

translations.literal: We deliberated: this matter can proceed without doubt.
translations.idiomatic: We concluded there was no doubt the project should proceed.

sentences.zh: 然雖軍民相參，選委廉幹官提督，行省山住子、行院董八都見子、行臺哈剌<角┦>令親詣相視，會計合用軍夫擬稟。」

translations.literal: However, though military and civilians were to be combined, upright and capable officials were to be selected to supervise; branch secretariat Shan Zhuzi, branch court Dong Badujianzi, and branch censorate Haralu were ordered to go personally to inspect, calculate the required military and corvée labor, and prepare a report."
translations.idiomatic: Military and civilian labor would be combined under capable supervisors. Shan Zhuzi of the branch secretariat, Dong Badujianzi of the branch court, and Haralu of the branch censorate were ordered to inspect the site in person, calculate the labor required, and submit a plan.

sentences.zh: 世祖曰：「利益美事，舉行已晚，其行之。」

translations.literal: Emperor Shizu said: "A beneficial and fine affair—carrying it out is already late; proceed with it."
translations.idiomatic: Kublai replied, "This is a worthy project, and we have waited too long already. Carry it out."

sentences.zh: 既而平章鐵哥言：「委官相視，計用夫十二萬，百日可畢。

translations.literal: Then Pacifying Minister Tiege stated: "Commissioned officials inspected the site; estimated labor use 120,000 men; one hundred days could complete it.
translations.idiomatic: Pacifying Minister Tiege then reported that officials had inspected the site and estimated 120,000 laborers could finish the work in one hundred days.

sentences.zh: 昨奏軍民共役，今民丁數多，不須調軍。」

translations.literal: Yesterday we memorialized combined military and civilian service; now civilian labor numbers are great—there is no need to mobilize troops."
translations.idiomatic: We had previously proposed combined military and civilian service, but civilian labor was now sufficient and troops need not be mobilized.

sentences.zh: 世祖曰：「有損有益，咸令均齊，毋自疑惑，其均科之。」

translations.literal: Emperor Shizu said: "Where there is loss and benefit, make all equal and even; do not doubt yourselves—distribute the levy evenly."
translations.idiomatic: Kublai replied, "Share both burdens and benefits equally. Do not hesitate—levy the labor evenly."

sentences.zh: 至元三十一年，世祖崩，成宗即位。

translations.literal: In the thirty-first year of the Zhiyuan era, Emperor Shizu died and Emperor Chengzong ascended the throne.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhiyuan 31 Kublai died and Temür succeeded him as Chengzong.

sentences.zh: 平章鐵哥奏：「太湖、澱山湖昨嘗奏過先帝，差倩民夫二十萬疏掘已畢。

translations.literal: Pacifying Minister Tiege memorialized: "Tai Lake and Dianshan Lake were previously reported to the late emperor; 200,000 civilian laborers were dispatched and dredging is already complete.
translations.idiomatic: Pacifying Minister Tiege reported that Tai Lake and Dianshan Lake had been dredged by 200,000 civilian laborers as previously approved by the late emperor.

sentences.zh: 今諸河日受兩潮，漸致沙漲，若不依舊宋例，令軍屯守，必致坐隳成功。

translations.literal: Now the various rivers daily receive the two tides and gradually accumulate sand; if troops are not garrisoned following the old Song precedent, success will inevitably be ruined by inaction.
translations.idiomatic: The rivers now receive tidal flow twice daily and are silting up again. Unless troops are garrisoned as under the Song, the earlier work will be wasted.

sentences.zh: 臣等議，常時工役撥軍，樞府猶且吝惜，屯守河道用軍八千，必辭不遣。

translations.literal: We deliberated: for regular labor the Privy Council is already stingy about assigning troops; garrisoning the river channels would use eight thousand troops—they will certainly refuse to dispatch them.
translations.idiomatic: We noted that the Privy Council already resisted assigning troops for routine labor and would surely refuse to garrison eight thousand men on the river channels.

sentences.zh: 澱山湖圍田賦糧二萬石，就以募民夫四千，調軍士四千與同屯守。

translations.literal: Dianshan Lake enclosed-field tax grain is 20,000 shi; use that to recruit four thousand civilian laborers and mobilize four thousand soldiers to garrison jointly.
translations.idiomatic: The enclosed fields around Dianshan Lake yielded 20,000 shi in tax grain. That revenue could fund four thousand civilian laborers and four thousand soldiers for joint garrison duty.

sentences.zh: 立都水防田使司，職掌收捕海賊，修治河渠圍田。」

translations.literal: Establish a Metropolitan Water and Field Defense Commissionerate, with duties of capturing sea pirates and repairing river channels and enclosed fields."
translations.idiomatic: They proposed establishing a Metropolitan Water and Field Defense Commissionerate to capture sea pirates and maintain the channels and enclosed fields.

sentences.zh: 命伯顏察兒暨樞密院議畢聞奏。

translations.literal: Bayancha'er and the Privy Council were ordered to deliberate and report when finished.
translations.idiomatic: Bayancha'er and the Privy Council were ordered to deliberate and report back.

sentences.zh: 於是樞府言：「嘗奏澱山湖在宋時設軍屯守，範殿帥、朱、張輩必知其故，擬與省官集議定稟奏，有旨從之。

translations.literal: Thereupon the Privy Council stated: "We previously reported that Dianshan Lake in Song times had troop garrisons; Fan Diandai, Zhu, Zhang, and others must know the reason; we plan to gather with provincial officials for deliberation, fix policy, and report—an decree approved this.
translations.idiomatic: The Privy Council replied that Dianshan Lake had been garrisoned in Song times and that Fan Diandai, Zhu, Zhang, and others would know the details. They proposed conferring with provincial officials before submitting a final plan, and the emperor approved.

sentences.zh: 乃集樞府官及範殿帥等共議，朱、張言：『宋時屯守河道，用手號軍，大處千人，小處不下三四百，隸巡檢司管領。』

translations.literal: They then gathered Privy Council officials and Fan Diandai and others for joint deliberation; Zhu and Zhang stated: "In Song times river channels were garrisoned with hand-numbered troops—large places one thousand men, small places no fewer than three or four hundred, subordinate to patrol offices for management."
translations.idiomatic: Privy Council officials met with Fan Diandai and others. Zhu and Zhang explained that in Song times the channels had been garrisoned by registered troops—about one thousand at major posts and no fewer than three or four hundred at smaller ones—under patrol offices.

sentences.zh: 範殿帥言：『差夫四千，非動搖四十萬戶不可，若令五千軍屯守，就委萬戶一員提調，事或可行。』

translations.literal: Fan Diandai stated: "Assigning four thousand corvée laborers would unavoidably disturb four hundred thousand households; if five thousand troops were ordered to garrison, commissioning one wanhu to supervise—the matter might be feasible."
translations.idiomatic: Fan Diandai argued that assigning four thousand corvée laborers would burden four hundred thousand households, but five thousand garrison troops under a wanhu commander might be workable.

sentences.zh: 臣等亦以為然，與都水巡防萬戶府職名，俾隸行院。」

translations.literal: We also considered this correct, and together with the title Metropolitan Water Patrol Wanhu Office, made it subordinate to the branch court."
translations.idiomatic: We agreed and proposed creating a Metropolitan Water Patrol Wanhu Office subordinate to the branch military court.

sentences.zh: 樞府官又言：「若與知源委之人詢其詳，候至都定議。」

translations.literal: Privy Council officials also stated: "If persons knowledgeable about the source and details are consulted, wait until reaching the capital to fix policy."
translations.idiomatic: Privy Council officials added that knowledgeable officials should be consulted in detail and a final decision deferred until the capital.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: This was approved.

sentences.zh: 鹽官州海塘

translations.literal: Yanguan Prefecture Seawall
translations.idiomatic: Yanguan Prefecture Seawall

sentences.zh: 鹽官州去海岸三十里，舊有捍海塘二，後又添築咸塘，在宋時亦嘗崩陷。

translations.literal: Yanguan Prefecture is thirty li from the coast; it originally had two sea-defense dikes, and later an additional salt dike was built—in Song times these also sometimes collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: Yanguan Prefecture lay thirty li from the coast. It had originally had two sea dikes, with a salt dike added later; even in Song times these had sometimes failed.

sentences.zh: 成宗大德三年，塘岸崩，都省委禮部郎中遊中順，洎本省官相視，虛沙復漲，難於施力。

translations.literal: In the third year of Emperor Chengzong's Dade era, the dike bank collapsed; the metropolitan court commissioned Ministry of Rites Langzhong You Zhongshun, together with provincial officials, to inspect—the hollow sand re-accumulated, making it hard to apply force.
translations.idiomatic: In Chengzong's Dade 3 the dike collapsed. The central government sent Ministry of Rites Langzhong You Zhongshun with provincial officials to inspect the site, but loose sand had refilled the breach and made repairs difficult.

sentences.zh: 至仁宗延祐己未、庚申間，海汛失度，累壞民居，陷地三十餘里。

translations.literal: During the jiwei and gengshen years of Emperor Renzong's Yanyou era, the sea tide was out of measure, repeatedly destroying residences and sinking land for more than thirty li.
translations.idiomatic: During Renzong's Yanyou jiwei and gengshen years, abnormal tides repeatedly destroyed homes and submerged more than thirty li of land.

sentences.zh: 其時省憲官共議，宜於州後北門添築土塘，然後築石塘，東西長四十三里，後以潮汐沙漲而止。

translations.literal: At that time provincial and surveillance officials jointly deliberated: an earthen dike should be added north of the north gate behind the prefecture, then a stone dike built, forty-three li long east to west—later work stopped due to tidal sand accumulation.
translations.idiomatic: Provincial and surveillance officials then agreed to build an earthen dike north of the prefecture's rear gate, followed by a stone dike forty-three li long east to west. Work later halted as tidal sand continued to accumulate.

sentences.zh: 至泰定即位之四年二月間，風潮大作，沖捍海小塘，壞州郭四里。

translations.literal: In the second month of the fourth year after Taiding's enthronement, wind and tide rose greatly, striking the small sea-defense dike and destroying four li of the prefecture walls.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the fourth year of Taiding's reign, a violent storm tide breached the smaller sea dike and destroyed four li of the prefecture walls.

sentences.zh: 杭州路言：「與都水庸田司議，欲於北地築塘四十餘里，而工費浩大，莫若先修咸塘，增其高闊，填塞溝港，且浚深近北備塘濠塹，用樁密釘，庶可護禦。」

translations.literal: Hangzhou Circuit stated: "Deliberating with the Metropolitan Field and Water Commissionerate, we wish to build a dike of more than forty li in the northern area, but the labor and expense are vast—it would be better first to repair the salt dike, increase its height and width, fill in channels and creeks, and also dredge deep the northern reserve dike moat, using piles densely nailed—perhaps this can provide defense."
translations.idiomatic: Hangzhou Circuit reported that, consulting the Metropolitan Field and Water Commissionerate, it had considered building more than forty li of dike to the north but found the cost prohibitive. It proposed instead repairing the salt dike, raising and widening it, filling channels, deepening the northern reserve moat, and driving piles densely in place to hold the line.

sentences.zh: 江浙省準下本路修治。

translations.literal: The Zhejiang branch secretariat approved and sent orders to the circuit for repair.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhejiang branch secretariat approved the plan and ordered the circuit to proceed with repairs.

sentences.zh: 都水庸田司又言：「宜速差丁夫，當水入沖堵閉，其不敷工役，於仁和、錢塘及嘉興附近州縣諸色人戶內斟酌差倩，即目淪沒不已，旦夕誠為可慮。」

translations.literal: The Field and Water Commissionerate also stated: "Corvée laborers should quickly be assigned; when water rushes in, block and seal immediately; where labor is insufficient, from Renhe, Qiantang, and nearby Jiaxing prefectures and counties, various categories of households should be considered for assignment—at present submerging continues without end; day and night this is truly worrisome."
translations.idiomatic: The Field and Water Commissionerate urged immediate mobilization of corvée labor to block breaches as water rushed in, with additional workers drawn as needed from Renhe, Qiantang, and nearby Jiaxing counties. Land was still being lost daily, and the situation was urgent.

sentences.zh: 工部議：「海岸崩摧重事也，宜移文江浙行省，督催庸田使司、鹽運司及有司發丁夫修治，毋致侵犯城郭，貽害居民。」

translations.literal: The Ministry of Works deliberated: "Coast collapse is a grave matter; a document should be sent to the Zhejiang branch secretariat, urging the Field Commissionerate, Salt Transport Commissionerate, and local officials to dispatch corvée labor for repair, so that the prefecture walls are not invaded and residents harmed."
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Works ruled that coastal collapse was a grave matter and ordered the Zhejiang branch secretariat to press the Field Commissionerate, Salt Transport Commissionerate, and local officials to mobilize labor for repairs before the walls were breached and residents harmed.

sentences.zh: 五月五日，平章禿滿叠兒、茶乃、史參政等奏：「江浙省四月內，潮水沖破鹽官州海岸，令庸田司官征夫修堵，又令僧人誦經，復差人令天師致祭。

translations.literal: On the fifth day of the fifth month, Pacifying Ministers Tummandian'er, Chainai, Participating Minister Shi, and others memorialized: "Within the fourth month, Zhejiang province reported that the tide broke through Yanguan Prefecture's coast; Field Commissionerate officials were ordered to conscript labor for repair and blocking; monks were also ordered to chant sutras; envoys were again dispatched to have the Celestial Master perform sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: On the fifth of the fifth month, Pacifying Ministers Tummandian'er and Chainai and Participating Minister Shi reported that in April the tide had breached Yanguan Prefecture's coast. Field officials had been ordered to conscript labor for repairs, monks to chant sutras, and envoys sent to the Celestial Master to perform rites.

sentences.zh: 臣等集議，世祖時海岸嘗崩，遣使命天師祈祀，潮即退，今可令直省舍人伯顏奉御香，令天師依前例祈祀。」

translations.literal: We gathered for deliberation: in Emperor Shizu's time the coast once collapsed; envoys were sent ordering the Celestial Master to pray and sacrifice, and the tide immediately retreated—now the Direct Metropolitan Household attendant Bayan can be ordered to offer imperial incense, and the Celestial Master ordered to pray and sacrifice according to the former precedent."
translations.idiomatic: We recalled that when the coast had collapsed under Kublai, envoys had the Celestial Master perform rites and the tide receded. Bayan, attendant of the Direct Metropolitan Household, should now be sent with imperial incense for the Celestial Master to perform the rite as before.

sentences.zh: 制曰：「可。」

translations.literal: The decree stated: "Permitted."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor replied, "So ordered."

sentences.zh: 既而杭州路又言：「八月以來，秋潮洶湧，水勢愈大，見築沙地塘岸，東西八十餘步，造木櫃石囤以塞其要處。

translations.literal: Then Hangzhou Circuit again stated: "Since the eighth month, the autumn tide has surged violently and the water force grown greater; a sandy-land dike bank is presently being built, more than eighty paces east to west; wooden cages and stone cribs are being made to block the critical points.
translations.idiomatic: Hangzhou Circuit then reported that since August the autumn tide had grown fiercer. An earthen dike more than eighty paces long was under construction, with wooden cages and stone cribs placed at the critical breach points.

sentences.zh: 本省左丞相脫歡等議，安置石囤四千九百六十，抵禦鎪嚙，以救其急，擬比浙江立石塘，可為久遠。

translations.literal: Provincial Left Chancellor Tuogan and others deliberated: deploy 4,960 stone cribs to resist tidal erosion and save the urgent situation; proposed comparing with Zhejiang's stone dike construction—it can serve for the long term.
translations.idiomatic: Left Chancellor Tuogan and others proposed deploying 4,960 stone cribs to resist tidal erosion as an emergency measure, modeled on Zhejiang's stone dike construction for a more lasting solution.

sentences.zh: 計工物，用鈔七十九萬四千餘錠，糧四萬六千三百餘石，接續興修。」

translations.literal: Calculating work and materials: use 794,000-odd ingots of paper money, grain 46,300-odd shi; continue construction."
translations.idiomatic: The projected cost was more than 794,000 ingots of paper money and over 46,300 shi of grain, with construction to continue."

sentences.zh: 致和元年三月，省臣奏：「江浙省並庸田司官修築海塘，作竹蘧篨，內實以石，鱗次壘疊以禦潮勢，今又淪陷入海，見圖修治，倘得堅久之策，移文具報。

translations.literal: In the third month of the first year of the Zhihe era, provincial officials memorialized: "Zhejiang province and Field Commissionerate officials built the sea dike, making bamboo revetments filled within with stone, stacked in scale-like layers to resist the tide force—now it has again submerged into the sea; a repair map is presented; if a lasting plan can be obtained, send a full document and report.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of Zhihe 1, provincial officials reported that Zhejiang and Field Commissionerate officials had built the sea dike with bamboo revetments packed with stone in layered rows to resist the tide, but it had submerged again. They submitted a repair plan and asked for a durable long-term solution.

sentences.zh: 臣等集議，此重事也，旦夕駕幸上都，分官扈從，不得圓議。

translations.literal: We gathered for deliberation: this is a grave matter; soon the imperial carriage will travel to the Upper Capital, officials divided to escort—we cannot hold full deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: We agreed this was a grave matter, but the emperor was soon departing for the Upper Capital and officials were being assigned to the escort, leaving no time for a full council.

sentences.zh: 今差戶部尚書李家奴、工部尚書李嘉賓、樞密院屬衛指揮青山、副使洪灝、宣政僉院南哥班與行省左丞相脫歡及行臺、行宣政院、庸田使司諸臣，會議修治之方。

translations.literal: Now Households Minister Li Jianu, Works Minister Li Jiabin, Privy Council attached guard commander Qingshan, deputy Hong Hao, and Xuanzheng Commission Nan Geban are dispatched, together with branch secretariat Left Chancellor Tuogan and branch censorate, branch Xuanzheng Commission, and Field Commissionerate ministers, to confer on methods of repair.
translations.idiomatic: Households Minister Li Jianu, Works Minister Li Jiabin, guard commander Qingshan of the Privy Council, deputy Hong Hao, and Xuanzheng Commission officer Nan Geban were therefore dispatched to confer with Left Chancellor Tuogan and officials of the branch censorate, branch Xuanzheng Commission, and Field Commissionerate on repair methods.

sentences.zh: 合用軍夫，除戍守州縣關津外，酌量差撥，從便添支口糧。

translations.literal: Required military and corvée labor—except for garrisoning prefectures, counties, and passes—was to be appropriately assigned and dispatched, with extra rations added as convenient.
translations.idiomatic: The labor required, apart from troops already garrisoning prefectures and passes, would be assigned as appropriate, with supplementary rations provided as needed.

sentences.zh: 合役丁力，附近有田之民，及僧、道、也裏可溫、答失蠻等戶內點倩。

translations.literal: Corvée labor in total: from nearby landowners, and from among monks, Taoists, Yelikewen, Dashiman, and other households labor was selected.
translations.idiomatic: Corvée was to be levied from nearby landowners and from monks, Taoists, Christians, Muslims, and other registered households.

sentences.zh: 凡工役之時，諸人毋或沮壞，違者罪之。

translations.literal: Whenever work is underway, no one may obstruct or damage it; violators will be punished.
translations.idiomatic: During the work no one was to obstruct or sabotage the project; offenders would be punished.

sentences.zh: 合行事務，提調官移文稟奏施行。」

translations.literal: Matters to be carried out: supervising officials send documents memorializing for implementation."
translations.idiomatic: All related business was to be reported upward by the supervising officials for approval and execution.

sentences.zh: 有旨從之。

translations.literal: An edict approved.
translations.idiomatic: The proposal was approved by edict.

sentences.zh: 四月二十八日，朝廷所委官，洎行省臺院及庸田司等官議：「大德、延祐欲建石塘未就。

translations.literal: On the twenty-eighth day of the fourth month, officials commissioned by the court together with branch secretariat, censorate, surveillance, and Garrison Fields offices deliberated: 'In Dade and Yanyou stone dikes were intended but not completed.
translations.idiomatic: On the twenty-eighth day of the fourth month, court commissioners met with branch secretariat, censorate, surveillance, and Garrison Fields officials and noted that stone seawalls planned in the Dade and Yanyou eras had never been completed.

sentences.zh: 泰定四年春，潮水異常，增築土塘，不能抵禦，議置板塘，以水湧難施工，遂作蘧篨木櫃，間有漂沈，欲踵前議，疊石塘以圖久遠。

translations.literal: In spring of the fourth year of Zhiding tides were abnormal; earthen dikes were heightened but could not resist; plank dikes were proposed, but surging water made construction difficult, so rush-mat wooden cribs were made, some drifting and sinking; wishing to follow the earlier proposal, stone dikes were stacked for long-term planning.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the fourth year of Zhiding abnormal tides overwhelmed heightened earthen dikes. Plank walls were considered but the surge made work impossible, so rush-mat timber cribs were tried, though some washed away. Officials returned to the earlier plan of a stacked stone seawall for a lasting defense.

sentences.zh: 為地脈虛浮，比定海、浙江、海鹽地形水勢不同，由是造石囤於其壞處疊之，以救目前之急。

translations.literal: Because the ground was loose and floating, unlike the terrain and water force of Dinghai, Zhejiang, and Haiyan, stone cribs were therefore built at broken places and stacked to relieve the present urgency.
translations.idiomatic: Because the ground here was loose and unstable, unlike Dinghai, Zhejiang, or Haiyan, stone cribs were stacked at the breaches as an emergency measure.

sentences.zh: 已置石囤二十九里餘，不曾崩陷，略見成效。」

translations.literal: Stone cribs already placed for more than twenty-nine li have not collapsed; some effect is seen.'
translations.idiomatic: More than twenty-nine li of stone cribs had been set without collapse, showing modest success.

sentences.zh: 庸田司與各路官同議，東西接壘石囤十里，其六十里塘下舊河，就取土築塘，鑿東山之石以備崩損。

translations.literal: The Garrison Fields Office and officials of each circuit jointly deliberated: east and west connect stacked stone cribs for ten li; along the sixty-li dike the old river below—take earth there to build the dike, quarry Dongshan stone to guard against collapse.
translations.idiomatic: The Garrison Fields Office and circuit officials agreed to link the stone cribs for ten li east and west, build the sixty-li dike with earth from the old channel beneath it, and quarry Dongshan stone against future collapse.

sentences.zh: 文宗天歷元年十一月，都水庸田司言：「八月十日至十九日，正當大汛，潮勢不高，風平水穩。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the first year of Emperor Wenzong's Tianli era, the Directorate of Waterways and Garrison Fields reported: 'From the tenth to the nineteenth day of the eighth month, right at the great tide, the tidal force was not high, wind calm and water steady.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of the first year of the Tianli era, the Directorate of Waterways and Garrison Fields reported that during the great tide from the tenth to the nineteenth day of the eighth month, the surge was moderate and the sea calm.

sentences.zh: 十四日，祈請天妃入廟，自本州嶽廟東海北護岸鱗鱗相接。

translations.literal: On the fourteenth day the Heavenly Consort was invited into the temple; from this prefecture's mountain temple east along the sea the north protective banks joined scale upon scale.
translations.idiomatic: On the fourteenth day the goddess of the sea was invited into her temple; from the prefectural shrine eastward along the coast the northern protective banks lay in continuous line.

sentences.zh: 十五日至十九日，海岸沙漲，東西長七里餘，南北廣或三十步，或數十百步，漸見南北相接。

translations.literal: From the fifteenth to the nineteenth day the coast sand rose, seven-odd li long east to west, north to south sometimes thirty paces wide, sometimes tens or hundreds of paces, gradually seen joining north and south.
translations.idiomatic: From the fifteenth through the nineteenth day the shoreline accreted sand for more than seven li east to west, varying from thirty paces to hundreds of paces wide, until north and south gradually met.

sentences.zh: 西至石囤，已及五都，修築捍海塘與鹽塘相連，直抵巖門，障禦石囤。

translations.literal: West to the stone cribs, already reaching the fifth ward; the sea-defense dike and salt dike were built connected, straight to Yanmen, protecting the stone cribs.
translations.idiomatic: Westward to the stone cribs the work reached the fifth ward, linking the sea-defense and salt dikes straight to Yanmen to shield the cribs.

sentences.zh: 東至十一都六十里塘，東至東大尖山嘉興、平湖三路所修處海口。

translations.literal: East to the eleventh ward's sixty-li dike, east to the estuary at Dongdajianshan where Jiaxing and Pinghu three circuits repaired.
translations.idiomatic: Eastward it ran to the sixty-li dike of the eleventh ward and the estuary at Dongdajianshan repaired by the three circuits of Jiaxing and Pinghu.

sentences.zh: 自八月一日至二日，探海二丈五尺；

translations.literal: From the first to the second day of the eighth month, probing the sea showed two zhang five feet;
translations.idiomatic: On the first and second days of the eighth month the sea was sounded at two zhang five feet;

sentences.zh: 至十九日、二十日探之，先二丈者今一丈五尺，先一丈五尺者今一丈。

translations.literal: by the nineteenth and twentieth day probing: where it had been two zhang, now one zhang five feet; where one zhang five feet, now one zhang.
translations.idiomatic: by the nineteenth and twentieth it had shallowed to one zhang five feet where it had been two zhang, and to one zhang where it had been one zhang five feet.

sentences.zh: 西自六都仁和縣界赭山、雷山為首，添漲沙塗，已過五都四都，鹽官州廊東西二都，沙土流行，水勢俱淺。

translations.literal: West from the sixth ward at the boundary of Renhe County, Zhe Mountain and Lei Mountain as the head, added silt spread, already passing the fifth and fourth wards, Yanguan Prefecture's eastern and western wards in the corridor; sand and earth flowed, water force all shallow.
translations.idiomatic: Westward from the sixth ward at Renhe County's Zhe and Lei mountains, new silt had spread through the fifth and fourth wards and both wards of Yanguan Prefecture, leaving the water everywhere shallow.

sentences.zh: 二十日，復巡視自東至西岸腳漲沙，比之八月十七日漸增高闊。

translations.literal: On the twentieth day inspection again from east to the west bank foot: accreted sand compared with the seventeenth day of the eighth month gradually grew higher and wider.
translations.idiomatic: On the twentieth day a fresh inspection from east to west showed the accreted sand higher and broader than on the seventeenth.

sentences.zh: 二十七日至九月四日大汛，本州嶽廟東西，水勢俱淺，漲沙東過錢家橋海岸，元下石囤木植，並無頹圮，水息民安。」

translations.literal: From the twenty-seventh day to the fourth day of the ninth month at the great tide, east and west of this prefecture's mountain temple the water was all shallow; accreted sand passed east beyond Qianjiaqiao coast; the stone cribs and timber originally set were not damaged; water subsided and the people were at peace.'
translations.idiomatic: From the twenty-seventh day of the eighth month through the fourth day of the ninth, during the great tide, waters east and west of the prefectural shrine remained shallow. Sand built east beyond Qianjiaqiao, and the stone cribs and timber already in place held firm. The waters fell and the people were secure.

sentences.zh: 於是改鹽官州曰海寧州。

translations.literal: Thereupon Yanguan Prefecture was renamed Haining Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Yanguan Prefecture was accordingly renamed Haining Prefecture, "Pacified by the Sea."

sentences.zh: 龍山河道

translations.literal: Longshan River Channel
translations.idiomatic: The Longshan River Channel

sentences.zh: 龍山河在杭州城外，歲久淤塞。

translations.literal: The Longshan River is outside Hangzhou city walls; over years it has silted shut.
translations.idiomatic: The Longshan River outside Hangzhou's walls had long been choked with silt.

sentences.zh: 武宗至大元年，江浙省令史裴堅言：「杭州錢塘江，近年以來為沙塗壅漲，潮水遠去，離北岸十五里，舟楫不能到岸。

translations.literal: In the first year of Emperor Wuzong's Zhida era, Jiang-Zhe Branch Secretariat clerk Pei Jian said: 'Hangzhou's Qiantang River in recent years has been choked by sand bars; the tide recedes far, fifteen li from the north bank; boats cannot reach shore.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of the Zhida era, clerk Pei Jian of the Jiang-Zhe Branch Secretariat reported that the Qiantang River near Hangzhou had silted up in recent years, leaving the tide fifteen li from the north bank and preventing vessels from reaching shore.

sentences.zh: 商旅往來，募夫搬運十七八里，使諸物翔湧，生民失所，遞運官物，甚為煩擾。

translations.literal: Merchants traveling back and forth hire laborers to carry goods seventeen or eighteen li, making goods soar and surge; the people lose their place; relay transport of official goods is greatly troublesome.
translations.idiomatic: Traveling merchants had to hire porters for seventeen or eighteen li, goods were hoisted and hauled at great cost, the people were displaced, and official relay transport became a serious burden.

sentences.zh: 訪問宋時並江岸有南北古河一道，名龍山河，今浙江亭南至龍山閘約一十五里，糞壞填塞，兩岸居民間有侵占。

translations.literal: Inquiry found that in Song times along the riverbank there was an ancient north-south river called Longshan River; now from Zhejiang Pavilion south to Longshan Sluice about fifteen li, filled with filth and ruin, and riverside residents here and there encroached.
translations.idiomatic: Inquiry revealed that in Song times an ancient north-south channel called the Longshan River had run along the bank. From Zhejiang Pavilion south to Longshan Sluice, some fifteen li, it was now filled with refuse, with encroachments by residents on both banks.

sentences.zh: 跡其形勢，宜改修運河，開掘沙土，封閘搬載，直抵浙江，轉入兩處市河，免擔負之勞，生民獲惠。」

translations.literal: Tracing its terrain, it is fitting to rebuild the transport canal, excavate sand and earth, seal sluices for loading, reach straight to Zhejiang, turn into two market rivers, avoid the labor of carrying on shoulders, and the people receive benefit.'
translations.idiomatic: Given the terrain, the transport canal should be restored, sand excavated, sluices opened for loading, and traffic led straight to Zhejiang and into the two market channels, sparing porterage and benefiting the populace.

sentences.zh: 省下杭州路相視，錢塘縣城南上隅龍山河至橫河橋，委系舊河，居民侵占，起建房屋，若疏通以接運河，公私大便。

translations.literal: The province ordered Hangzhou Circuit to inspect: from Qiantang County city's south upper corner Longshan River to Henghe Bridge, truly the old river, residents encroached and built houses; if dredged open to connect the transport canal, public and private would greatly benefit.
translations.idiomatic: The province ordered Hangzhou Circuit to inspect the stretch from the upper south corner of Qiantang County city along the Longshan River to Henghe Bridge. It was the old channel, now built over by residents; if cleared and linked to the transport canal, the benefit to public and private interests would be great.

sentences.zh: 計工十五萬七千五百六十六，日役夫五千二百五十二，度可三十日畢。

translations.literal: Calculated work 157,566 units, daily laborers 5,252, estimated completable in thirty days.
translations.idiomatic: The project was estimated at 157,566 work units and 5,252 daily laborers, to be finished in thirty days.

sentences.zh: 所役夫於本路錄事司、仁和、錢塘縣富實之家差倩，就持筐檐鍬應役。

translations.literal: Laborers were assigned from this circuit's record office, Renhe and Qiantang counties' wealthy households, each bringing baskets, poles, hoes, and shovels for service.
translations.idiomatic: Labor was levied from wealthy households in the circuit record office and in Renhe and Qiantang counties, each man bringing baskets, poles, hoes, and shovels.

sentences.zh: 人日支官糧二升，該米三千一百五十一石三斗二升。

translations.literal: Each person daily two sheng official grain, totaling 3,151 shi 3 dou 2 sheng of rice.
translations.idiomatic: Each laborer received two sheng of official grain daily, totaling 3,151 shi 3 dou 2 sheng of rice.

sentences.zh: 河長九里三百六十二步，造石橋八，立上下二閘，計用鈔一百六十三錠二十三兩四錢七分七厘。

translations.literal: The river nine li 362 paces long; eight stone bridges built; upper and lower two sluices set; calculated use of paper money 163 ingots 23 liang 4 qian 7 fen 7 li.
translations.idiomatic: The channel ran nine li and 362 paces, with eight stone bridges and upper and lower sluices, at a cost of 163 ingots 23 liang 4 qian 7 fen 7 li in paper money.

sentences.zh: 省準咨請丞相脫脫總治其事，於仁宗延祐三年三月七日興工，至四月十八日工畢。

translations.literal: The province approved consulting Chief Counselor Toto to oversee the matter; work began on the seventh day of the third month of the third year of Emperor Renzong's Yanyou era and was completed on the eighteenth day of the fourth month.
translations.idiomatic: The province approved placing Chief Counselor Toto in overall charge. Work began on the seventh day of the third month of the third year of the Yanyou era and was completed on the eighteenth day of the fourth month.
